Require Import imports par geq conv syntax.

Module Type typing_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq).

Definition context := list (T * tm).

Inductive lookup : nat -> context -> T -> tm -> Prop :=
  | here ℓ A Γ : lookup 0 ((ℓ, A) :: Γ) ℓ (A ⟨shift⟩)
  | there n A Γ ℓ B :
      lookup n Γ ℓ A -> lookup (S n) (B :: Γ) ℓ (A ⟨shift⟩).

Definition lookup_good_renaming ξ Γ Δ :=
  forall i ℓ A, lookup i Γ ℓ A -> exists ℓ0, lookup (ξ i) Δ ℓ0 A⟨ξ⟩ /\ ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ.

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A" (at level 70).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (at level 70).

Definition c2e : context -> econtext := map (fun '(ℓ, _) => ℓ).

Inductive Wt : context -> T -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| T_Var Γ ℓ0 ℓ i A :
  ⊢ Γ ->
  lookup i Γ ℓ0 A ->
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

  Γ ⊢ (var_tm i) ; ℓ ∈ A

| T_Pi Γ i j ℓ ℓ0 A B :
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ B ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (max i j))

| T_Abs Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓ1 A a B i :
  Γ ⊢ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ1 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ B ->

  Γ ⊢ (tAbs ℓ0 a) ; ℓ ∈ (tPi ℓ0 A B)

| T_App Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A B b :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ (tApp a ℓ0 b) ; ℓ ∈ (B [ b.. ])

| T_Conv Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A B i :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ B ; ℓ0 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  conv (c2e Γ) A B ->

  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ B

| T_Zero Γ ℓ :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tZero ; ℓ ∈ tNat

| T_Suc Γ ℓ a :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ tNat ->

  Γ ⊢ tSuc a ; ℓ ∈ tNat

| T_Ind Γ ℓ ℓ0 a b c A ℓA i :
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  (ℓ0, tNat) :: Γ ⊢ A ; ℓA ∈ tUniv i ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A [tZero..] ->
  (ℓ0, A) :: (ℓ0, tNat) :: Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A[tSuc (var_tm 0) .: S >> var_tm]⟨S⟩ ->
  Γ ⊢ c ; ℓ0 ∈ tNat ->

  Γ ⊢ tInd ℓ0 a b c ; ℓ ∈ (A [c..])

| T_Nat Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tNat ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Univ Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ (tUniv i) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (S i))

| T_Void Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tVoid ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Absurd Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓ1 i a A :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ tVoid  ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ1 ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tAbsurd a ; ℓ ∈ A

| T_Refl Γ ℓ a ℓ0 A:
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ tRefl ; ℓ ∈ (tEq ℓ0 a a)

| T_Eq Γ ℓ ℓ0 a b A i:
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ (tEq ℓ0 a b) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i)

| T_J Γ t a b p A i j C ℓ ℓp ℓT ℓ0 ℓ1:
  ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ0 ->
  ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ1 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ1 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓT ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ p ; ℓp ∈ (tEq ℓ0 a b) ->


  ((ℓp, tEq ℓ0 (ren_tm shift a) (var_tm 0)) :: (ℓ1, A) :: Γ) ⊢ C ; ℓ0 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  Γ ⊢ t ; ℓ ∈ (C [tRefl .: a ..]) ->
  Γ ⊢ (tJ ℓp t p) ; ℓ ∈ (C [p .: b..])

| T_Sig Γ i j ℓ ℓ0 A B :
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ B ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ (tSig ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (max i j))

| T_Pack Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A b B ℓT i :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ B[a..] ->
  Γ ⊢ tSig ℓ0 A B ; ℓT ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tPack ℓ0 a b ; ℓ ∈ tSig ℓ0 A B

| T_Let Γ ℓ ℓp ℓ0 a b ℓT A B C i j k :
  ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓT ∈ tUniv j ->
  (ℓ0, A) :: Γ ⊢ B ; ℓT ∈ tUniv k ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓp ∈ tSig ℓ0 A B ->
  (ℓp, B) :: (ℓ0, A) :: Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ C[(tPack ℓ0 (var_tm 1) (var_tm 0)) .: (shift >> shift >> var_tm)] ->
  (ℓp, tSig ℓ0 A B) :: Γ ⊢ C ; ℓT ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tLet ℓ0 ℓp a b ; ℓ ∈ C[a ..]

| T_TT Γ ℓ :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tTT ; ℓ ∈ tUnit

| T_Unit Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tUnit ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Seq Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓC a b C i :
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ tUnit ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ C[tTT..] ->
  (ℓ0, tUnit) :: Γ ⊢ C ; ℓC ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tSeq ℓ0 a b ; ℓ ∈ C[a..]

with Wff : context -> Prop :=
| Wff_nil :

  ⊢ nil
| Wff_cons Γ ℓ0 ℓ A i :
  ⊢ Γ ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i ->

  ⊢ (ℓ0, A) :: Γ
where
  "Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A" := (Wt Γ ℓ a A) and "⊢ Γ" := (Wff Γ).

Scheme wt_ind := Induction for Wt Sort Prop
    with wff_ind := Induction for Wff Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme wt_mutual from wt_ind, wff_ind.

End typing_sig.

Require Import imports.

Module Type par_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Reserved Infix "⇒" (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive Par : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| P_Var i :

  (var_tm i) ⇒ (var_tm i)
| P_Univ n :

  (tUniv n) ⇒ (tUniv n)
| P_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) ⇒ (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
| P_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->

  (tAbs ℓ0 a0) ⇒ (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
| P_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
| P_AppAbs a a0 b0 b1 ℓ0 :
  (a ⇒ a0) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp (tAbs ℓ0 a) ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (a0 [b1..])

| P_Void :
  tVoid ⇒ tVoid

| P_Absurd a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tAbsurd a ⇒ tAbsurd b

| P_Refl :

  tRefl ⇒ tRefl

| P_Eq ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) ⇒ (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

| P_J ℓp t0 p0 t1 p1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->
  (p0 ⇒ p1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 p0) ⇒ (tJ ℓp t1 p1)

| P_JRefl ℓp t0 t1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 tRefl) ⇒ t1

| P_Sig ℓ A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  tSig ℓ A0 B0 ⇒ tSig ℓ A1 B1

| P_Pack ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tPack ℓ a0 b0) ⇒ (tPack ℓ a1 b1)

| P_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 ⇒ tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1

| P_LetPack ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->
  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) c0 ⇒ c1[b1 .: a1 ..]

| P_Zero :

  tZero ⇒ tZero

| P_Suc a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tSuc a ⇒ tSuc b

| P_Ind ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 c0 ⇒ tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1

| P_IndZero ℓ a0 a1 b:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b tZero ⇒ a1
| P_IndSuc ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 (tSuc c0) ⇒ b1 [(tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1) .: c1  ..]
| P_Nat :

  tNat ⇒ tNat

| P_TT :

  tTT ⇒ tTT

| P_Seq ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ a0 b0 ⇒ tSeq ℓ a1 b1

| P_SeqTT ℓ b0 b1 :
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ tTT b0 ⇒ b1

| P_Unit :

  tUnit ⇒ tUnit

where "A ⇒ B" := (Par A B).

Infix "⇒*" := (rtc Par) (at level 60, right associativity).

End par_sig.
=== GEQ ===
Require Import imports.

Module Type geq_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Definition econtext := list T.

Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition elookup i Ξ (ℓ : T) := nth_error Ξ i = Some ℓ.

Inductive IOk (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> Prop :=
  | IO_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (var_tm i)
  | IO_Univ i :

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tUniv i)
  | IO_Pi ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A B)
  | IO_Abs ℓ0 a :
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a)

Require Import imports.

Module Type par_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Reserved Infix "⇒" (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive Par : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| P_Var i :

  (var_tm i) ⇒ (var_tm i)
| P_Univ n :

  (tUniv n) ⇒ (tUniv n)
| P_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) ⇒ (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
| P_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->

  (tAbs ℓ0 a0) ⇒ (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
| P_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
| P_AppAbs a a0 b0 b1 ℓ0 :
  (a ⇒ a0) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp (tAbs ℓ0 a) ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (a0 [b1..])

| P_Void :
  tVoid ⇒ tVoid

| P_Absurd a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tAbsurd a ⇒ tAbsurd b

| P_Refl :

  tRefl ⇒ tRefl

| P_Eq ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) ⇒ (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

| P_J ℓp t0 p0 t1 p1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->
  (p0 ⇒ p1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 p0) ⇒ (tJ ℓp t1 p1)

| P_JRefl ℓp t0 t1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 tRefl) ⇒ t1

| P_Sig ℓ A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  tSig ℓ A0 B0 ⇒ tSig ℓ A1 B1

| P_Pack ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tPack ℓ a0 b0) ⇒ (tPack ℓ a1 b1)

| P_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 ⇒ tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1

| P_LetPack ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->
  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) c0 ⇒ c1[b1 .: a1 ..]

| P_Zero :

  tZero ⇒ tZero

| P_Suc a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tSuc a ⇒ tSuc b

| P_Ind ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 c0 ⇒ tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1

| P_IndZero ℓ a0 a1 b:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b tZero ⇒ a1
| P_IndSuc ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 (tSuc c0) ⇒ b1 [(tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1) .: c1  ..]
| P_Nat :

  tNat ⇒ tNat

| P_TT :

  tTT ⇒ tTT

| P_Seq ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ a0 b0 ⇒ tSeq ℓ a1 b1

| P_SeqTT ℓ b0 b1 :
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ tTT b0 ⇒ b1

| P_Unit :

  tUnit ⇒ tUnit

where "A ⇒ B" := (Par A B).

Infix "⇒*" := (rtc Par) (at level 60, right associativity).

End par_sig.

Require Export axioms.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Notation fin := nat.

Notation shift := S (only parsing).

Definition var_zero := 0.

Definition id {X} (x: X) := x.

Definition scons {X: Type} (x : X) (xi : nat -> X) :=
  fun n => match n with
          |0 => x
          |S n => xi n
          end.

Notation "s .: sigma" := (scons s sigma) (at level 70).

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1 xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=

  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition cons_env (P : Prop) (D : nat -> Prop) : nat -> Prop :=
  fun n => match n with 0 => P | S k => D k end.

Fixpoint Sat (A : tm) (D : nat -> Prop) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | var_tm i => D i
  | tAbs _ _ => True
  | tApp _ _ _ => True
  | tPi _ C B => forall P, Sat C D -> Sat B (cons_env P D)
  | tUniv _ => True
  | tVoid => False
  | tAbsurd _ => True
  | tEq _ _ _ => True
  | tJ _ _ _ => True
  | tRefl => True
  | tSig _ C B => forall P, Sat C D -> Sat B (cons_env P D)
  | tPack _ _ _ => True
  | tLet _ _ _ _ => True
  | tZero => True
  | tSuc _ => True
  | tInd _ _ _ _ => True
  | tNat => True
  | tTT => True
  | tSeq _ _ _ => True
  | tUnit => True
  end.

Ltac solve_triv :=
  match goal with
  | |- (?P <-> ?P) => split; auto
  | |- (True <-> True) => split; auto
  | |- (False <-> False) => split; auto
  end.

Lemma Sat_congr : forall A D1 D2, (forall i, D1 i <-> D2 i) -> (Sat A D1 <-> Sat A D2).

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
From Coq Require Import Program.Equality.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)

(* Rigidity of IEq on head constructors *)
Lemma IEq_void_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tVoid A -> A = tVoid.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_univ_inv : forall Xi l n A, IEq Xi l (tUniv n) A -> A = tUniv n.
Proof. intros Xi l n A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_nat_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tNat A -> A = tNat.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_unit_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tUnit A -> A = tUnit.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_pi_inv : forall Xi l l0 C D A, IEq Xi l (tPi l0 C D) A -> exists C' D', A = tPi l0 C' D'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 C D A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.
Lemma IEq_sig_inv : forall Xi l l0 C D A, IEq Xi l (tSig l0 C D) A -> exists C' D', A = tSig l0 C' D'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 C D A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.
Lemma IEq_eq_inv : forall Xi l l0 a b A, IEq Xi l (tEq l0 a b) A -> exists a' b', A = tEq l0 a' b'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 a b A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.

(* Par head preservation (rtc) *)
Definition Voidy (A : tm) : Prop := rtc Par A tVoid.

Lemma rtc_inv (P : tm -> Prop) :
  (forall a b, Par a b -> P a -> P b) ->
  forall a b, rtc Par a b -> P a -> P b.
Proof. intros HP a b H. induction H; intros Ha; [exact Ha|]. apply IHrtc. eapply HP; eauto. Qed.

Definition hpi t := exists l A B, t = tPi l A B.
Definition huniv t := exists n, t = tUniv n.
Definition hnat t := t = tNat.
Definition hunit t := t = tUnit.
Definition hsig t := exists l A B, t = tSig l A B.
Definition heq t := exists l a b, t = tEq l a b.

Lemma Par_hpi a b : Par a b -> hpi a -> hpi b.
Proof. intros H [l [A [B E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_huniv a b : Par a b -> huniv a -> huniv b.
Proof. intros H [n E]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hnat a b : Par a b -> hnat a -> hnat b.
Proof. intros H E; subst a; inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hunit a b : Par a b -> hunit a -> hunit b.
Proof. intros H E; subst a; inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hsig a b : Par a b -> hsig a -> hsig b.
Proof. intros H [l [A [B E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_heq a b : Par a b -> heq a -> heq b.
Proof. intros H [l [x [y E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma rtc_hpi a b : rtc Par a b -> hpi a -> hpi b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hpi. Qed.
Lemma rtc_huniv a b : rtc Par a b -> huniv a -> huniv b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_huniv. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hnat a b : rtc Par a b -> hnat a -> hnat b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hnat. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hunit a b : rtc Par a b -> hunit a -> hunit b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hunit. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hsig a b : rtc Par a b -> hsig a -> hsig b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hsig. Qed.
Lemma rtc_heq a b : rtc Par a b -> heq a -> heq b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_heq. Qed.

Proof.
  intros Xi A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].

Qed.
Lemma conv_univ_nat : forall Xi n A, conv Xi (tUniv n) A -> huniv A.
Proof.
  intros Xi n A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (huniv c0) by (apply rtc_huniv in H0; exact H0).
  destruct (IEq_univ_inv Xi l n c0 H2) as ->.
  apply rtc_huniv in H1. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma conv_void : forall Xi A, conv Xi tVoid A -> Voidy A.
Proof.
  intros Xi A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (c0 = tVoid) as E.

Lemma voidy_univ : forall n, ~ Voidy (tUniv n).
Proof. intros n H. assert (huniv tVoid) by (apply rtc_huniv in H; exact H). destruct H0 as [m E]; discriminate E. Qed.
Lemma voidy_nat : ~ Voidy tNat.
Proof. intros H. assert (hnat tVoid) by (apply rtc_hnat in H; exact H). discriminate H0. Qed.
Lemma voidy_unit : ~ Voidy tUnit.
Proof. intros H. assert (hunit tVoid) by (apply rtc_hunit in H; exact H). discriminate H0. Qed.
Lemma voidy_pi : forall l A B, ~ Voidy (tPi l A B).
Proof. intros l A B H. assert (hpi tVoid) by (apply rtc_hpi in H; exact H). destruct H0 as [l' [A' [B' E]]]; discriminate E. Qed.

End ex.

Both are exactly what the (unused) `IOk`/`IEq`/`iok_ren_ok`/`iok_subst_ok` machinery is for: they are the level-indexed neutral/canonical relations of a derivation-directed realizer/normalization model with a universe of codes carrying denotations. `Task.v` is still the supplied skeleton; no `admit`, `Admitted`, axiom, unsound flag, or support-file change was introduced. The target is not proved, and I cannot honestly report otherwise. The remaining work is the full level-indexed realizer model plus `Par`/`IEq` confluence and substitution metatheory; I can continue building toward it, but I cannot promise it converges, and I will not fake a completion.

Require Import imports.

Module Type geq_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Definition econtext := list T.

Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition elookup i Ξ (ℓ : T) := nth_error Ξ i = Some ℓ.

Inductive IOk (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> Prop :=
  | IO_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (var_tm i)
  | IO_Univ i :

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tUniv i)
  | IO_Pi ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A B)
  | IO_Abs ℓ0 a :
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a)
  | IO_App a ℓ0 b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tApp a ℓ0 b)
  | IO_Void :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tVoid
  | IO_Absurd ℓ0 a:
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a)
  | IO_Refl :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tRefl
  | IO_Eq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a b)
  | IO_J ℓp t p :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ t ->
    IOk Ξ ℓp p ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t p)

  | IO_Sig ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A B)

  | IO_Pack ℓ0 a b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a b)

  | IO_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a b :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ1 a ->
    IOk (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a b)

  | IO_Zero :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tZero

  | IO_Suc a :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSuc a)

  | IO_Ind ℓ0 a b c :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ0 b ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 c ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a b c)

  | IO_Nat :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tNat

  | IO_Unit :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tUnit

  | IO_TT :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tTT

  | IO_Seq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a b).

Inductive IEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | I_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (var_tm i) (var_tm i)
  | I_Univ i :

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tUniv i) (tUniv i)
  | I_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ A0 A1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
  | I_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a0) (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
  | I_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
  | I_Void :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tVoid tVoid
  | I_Absurd a b :

Require Import imports.

Module Type geq_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Definition econtext := list T.

Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition elookup i Ξ (ℓ : T) := nth_error Ξ i = Some ℓ.

Inductive IOk (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> Prop :=
  | IO_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (var_tm i)
  | IO_Univ i :

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tUniv i)
  | IO_Pi ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A B)
  | IO_Abs ℓ0 a :
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a)
  | IO_App a ℓ0 b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tApp a ℓ0 b)
  | IO_Void :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tVoid
  | IO_Absurd ℓ0 a:
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a)
  | IO_Refl :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tRefl
  | IO_Eq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a b)
  | IO_J ℓp t p :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ t ->
    IOk Ξ ℓp p ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t p)

  | IO_Sig ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A B)

  | IO_Pack ℓ0 a b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a b)

  | IO_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a b :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ1 a ->
    IOk (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a b)

  | IO_Zero :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tZero

  | IO_Suc a :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSuc a)

  | IO_Ind ℓ0 a b c :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ0 b ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 c ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a b c)

  | IO_Nat :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tNat

  | IO_Unit :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tUnit

  | IO_TT :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tTT

  | IO_Seq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a b).

Inductive IEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | I_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

  | I_Univ i :

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tUniv i) (tUniv i)

    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

  | I_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a0 a1 ->

  | I_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
  | I_Void :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tVoid tVoid
  | I_Absurd a b :
    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a) (tAbsurd b)
  | I_Refl :

  | I_Eq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) (tPack ℓ0 a1 b1)

  | I_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0) (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1)

  | I_Zero :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tZero tZero

  | I_Suc a0 a1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSuc a0) (tSuc a1)

  | I_Ind ℓ0 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ c0 c1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a0 b0 c0) (tInd ℓ0 a1 b1 c1)

  | I_Nat :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tNat tNat

  | I_Unit :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tUnit tUnit

  | I_TT :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tTT tTT

  | I_Seq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tSeq ℓ0 a1 b1)

  with GIEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : T -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | GI_Dist ℓ0 A B :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ A B ->

    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 A B
  | GI_InDist ℓ0 A B :
    ~ (ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ) ->

      with GIEq_ind' := Induction for GIEq Sort Prop.

mkdir -p /tmp/ce && cat > /tmp/ce/R1.v <<'EOF'
Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
From Coq Require Import Program.Equality.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).
Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Rigidity of IEq on head constructors *)
Lemma IEq_void_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tVoid A -> A = tVoid.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_univ_inv : forall Xi l n A, IEq Xi l (tUniv n) A -> A = tUniv n.
Proof. intros Xi l n A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_nat_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tNat A -> A = tNat.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_unit_inv : forall Xi l A, IEq Xi l tUnit A -> A = tUnit.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma IEq_pi_inv : forall Xi l l0 C D A, IEq Xi l (tPi l0 C D) A -> exists C' D', A = tPi l0 C' D'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 C D A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.
Lemma IEq_sig_inv : forall Xi l l0 C D A, IEq Xi l (tSig l0 C D) A -> exists C' D', A = tSig l0 C' D'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 C D A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.
Lemma IEq_eq_inv : forall Xi l l0 a b A, IEq Xi l (tEq l0 a b) A -> exists a' b', A = tEq l0 a' b'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 a b A H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.

(* Par head preservation (rtc) *)
Definition Voidy (A : tm) : Prop := rtc Par A tVoid.

Lemma rtc_inv (P : tm -> Prop) :
  (forall a b, Par a b -> P a -> P b) ->
  forall a b, rtc Par a b -> P a -> P b.
Proof. intros HP a b H. induction H; intros Ha; [exact Ha|]. apply IHrtc. eapply HP; eauto. Qed.

Definition hpi t := exists l A B, t = tPi l A B.
Definition huniv t := exists n, t = tUniv n.
Definition hnat t := t = tNat.
Definition hunit t := t = tUnit.
Definition hsig t := exists l A B, t = tSig l A B.
Definition heq t := exists l a b, t = tEq l a b.

Lemma Par_hpi a b : Par a b -> hpi a -> hpi b.
Proof. intros H [l [A [B E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_huniv a b : Par a b -> huniv a -> huniv b.
Proof. intros H [n E]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hnat a b : Par a b -> hnat a -> hnat b.
Proof. intros H E; subst a; inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hunit a b : Par a b -> hunit a -> hunit b.
Proof. intros H E; subst a; inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_hsig a b : Par a b -> hsig a -> hsig b.
Proof. intros H [l [A [B E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Par_heq a b : Par a b -> heq a -> heq b.
Proof. intros H [l [x [y E]]]; subst a; inversion H; repeat eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma rtc_hpi a b : rtc Par a b -> hpi a -> hpi b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hpi. Qed.
Lemma rtc_huniv a b : rtc Par a b -> huniv a -> huniv b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_huniv. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hnat a b : rtc Par a b -> hnat a -> hnat b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hnat. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hunit a b : rtc Par a b -> hunit a -> hunit b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hunit. Qed.
Lemma rtc_hsig a b : rtc Par a b -> hsig a -> hsig b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_hsig. Qed.
Lemma rtc_heq a b : rtc Par a b -> heq a -> heq b. Proof. apply rtc_inv, Par_heq. Qed.

(* conv cannot relate rigid heads to different rigid heads *)
Lemma conv_nat_univ : forall Xi A, conv Xi tNat A -> hnat A.
Proof.
  intros Xi A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (hnat c0) by (apply rtc_hnat in H0; exact H0).
  destruct (IEq_nat_inv Xi l c0 H2) as ->.
  apply rtc_hnat in H1. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma conv_univ_nat : forall Xi n A, conv Xi (tUniv n) A -> huniv A.
Proof.
  intros Xi n A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (huniv c0) by (apply rtc_huniv in H0; exact H0).
  destruct (IEq_univ_inv Xi l n c0 H2) as ->.
  apply rtc_huniv in H1. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma conv_void : forall Xi A, conv Xi tVoid A -> Voidy A.
Proof.
  intros Xi A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (c0 = tVoid) as E.
  { assert (Voidy_h : rtc Par tVoid c0) by exact H0.
    remember tVoid as t eqn:Et. revert Et H0.
    induction Voidy_h; intros Et H0; subst.
    - reflexivity.
    - inversion H; subst. apply IHrtc; reflexivity. }
  subst c0. destruct (IEq_void_inv Xi l c1 H2) as ->.
  exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma voidy_univ : forall n, ~ Voidy (tUniv n).
Proof. intros n H. assert (huniv tVoid) by (apply rtc_huniv in H; exact H). destruct H0 as [m E]; discriminate E. Qed.
Lemma voidy_nat : ~ Voidy tNat.
Proof. intros H. assert (hnat tVoid) by (apply rtc_hnat in H; exact H). discriminate H0. Qed.
Lemma voidy_unit : ~ Voidy tUnit.
Proof. intros H. assert (hunit tVoid) by (apply rtc_hunit in H; exact H). discriminate H0. Qed.
Lemma voidy_pi : forall l A B, ~ Voidy (tPi l A B).
Proof. intros l A B H. assert (hpi tVoid) by (apply rtc_hpi in H; exact H). destruct H0 as [l' [A' [B' E]]]; discriminate E. Qed.

End ex.
EOF

Require Import imports.

Module Type par_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Reserved Infix "⇒" (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive Par : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| P_Var i :

  (var_tm i) ⇒ (var_tm i)
| P_Univ n :

  (tUniv n) ⇒ (tUniv n)
| P_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) ⇒ (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
| P_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->

  (tAbs ℓ0 a0) ⇒ (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
| P_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
| P_AppAbs a a0 b0 b1 ℓ0 :
  (a ⇒ a0) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp (tAbs ℓ0 a) ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (a0 [b1..])

| P_Void :
  tVoid ⇒ tVoid

| P_Absurd a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tAbsurd a ⇒ tAbsurd b

| P_Refl :

  tRefl ⇒ tRefl

| P_Eq ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) ⇒ (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

| P_J ℓp t0 p0 t1 p1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->
  (p0 ⇒ p1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 p0) ⇒ (tJ ℓp t1 p1)

| P_JRefl ℓp t0 t1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 tRefl) ⇒ t1

| P_Sig ℓ A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  tSig ℓ A0 B0 ⇒ tSig ℓ A1 B1

| P_Pack ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tPack ℓ a0 b0) ⇒ (tPack ℓ a1 b1)

| P_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 ⇒ tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1

| P_LetPack ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->
  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) c0 ⇒ c1[b1 .: a1 ..]

| P_Zero :

  tZero ⇒ tZero

| P_Suc a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tSuc a ⇒ tSuc b

| P_Ind ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 c0 ⇒ tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1

| P_IndZero ℓ a0 a1 b:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b tZero ⇒ a1
| P_IndSuc ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 (tSuc c0) ⇒ b1 [(tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1) .: c1  ..]
| P_Nat :

  tNat ⇒ tNat

| P_TT :

  tTT ⇒ tTT

| P_Seq ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ a0 b0 ⇒ tSeq ℓ a1 b1

| P_SeqTT ℓ b0 b1 :
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ tTT b0 ⇒ b1

| P_Unit :

  tUnit ⇒ tUnit

where "A ⇒ B" := (Par A B).

Infix "⇒*" := (rtc Par) (at level 60, right associativity).

End par_sig.

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.

From Coq Require Import ssreflect.

Declare Scope lattice_scope.

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Module Type Lattice.

Parameter T : Set.

Parameter meet : T -> T -> T.

Parameter join : T -> T -> T.

Parameter T_eqb : T -> T -> bool.

Infix "∪" := join (at level 65) : lattice_scope.

Infix "∩" := meet (at level 60) : lattice_scope.

Notation "a ⊆ b" := (a ∩ b = a) (at level 70, no associativity) : lattice_scope.

Parameter meet_commutative : forall a b, a ∩ b = b ∩ a.

Parameter meet_associative : forall a b c, (a ∩ b) ∩ c = a ∩ (b ∩ c).

Parameter meet_absorptive : forall a b, a ∩ (a ∪ b) = a.

Parameter meet_idempotent : forall a, a ∩ a = a.

Parameter join_commutative : forall a b, a ∪ b = b ∪ a.

Parameter join_associative: forall a b c, (a ∪ b) ∪ c = a ∪ (b ∪ c).

Parameter join_absorptive : forall a b, a ∪ (a ∩ b) = a.

Parameter join_idempotent : forall a, a ∪ a = a.

Parameter T_eqdec : forall a b, Bool.reflect (a = b) (T_eqb a b).

End Lattice.

Require Export Lattice.All.

Require Export unscoped.

Module Type syntax_sig
  (Export lattice : Lattice).

Section tm.

Inductive tm  : Type :=
  | var_tm : ( fin ) -> tm
  | tAbs : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tApp : ( tm   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPi : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUniv : ( nat   ) -> tm
  | tVoid : tm
  | tAbsurd : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tEq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tJ : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tRefl : tm
  | tSig : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPack : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tLet : ( T   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tZero : tm
  | tSuc : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tInd : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tNat : tm
  | tTT : tm
  | tSeq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUnit : tm .

Definition upRen_tm_tm   (xi : ( fin ) -> fin) : ( fin ) -> fin :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_tm   (xitm : ( fin ) -> fin) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => (var_tm ) (xitm s)
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((ren_tm xitm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s2) ((ren_tm xitm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

Definition up_tm_tm   (sigma : ( fin ) -> tm ) : ( fin ) -> tm  :=
  (scons) ((var_tm ) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_tm (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_tm   (sigmatm : ( fin ) -> tm ) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => sigmatm s
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s2) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

End tm.

Global Instance Subst_tm   : Subst1 (( fin ) -> tm ) (tm ) (tm ) := @subst_tm   .

Global Instance Ren_tm   : Ren1 (( fin ) -> fin) (tm ) (tm ) := @ren_tm   .

Global Instance VarInstance_tm  : Var (fin) (tm ) := @var_tm  .

  | tPi : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUniv : ( nat   ) -> tm
  | tVoid : tm
  | tAbsurd : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tEq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tJ : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tRefl : tm
  | tSig : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPack : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tLet : ( T   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm

  | tInd : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tNat : tm
  | tTT : tm

Definition upRen_tm_tm   (xi : ( fin ) -> fin) : ( fin ) -> fin :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_tm   (xitm : ( fin ) -> fin) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => (var_tm ) (xitm s)
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((ren_tm xitm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)

    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)

    end.

    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)

    | tZero   => tZero

    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s2) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).
Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ⊆ b -> b ⊆ c -> a ⊆ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. unfold "⊆" in *.
  rewrite <- Hab. rewrite meet_associative. rewrite <- Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

Lemma wt_ieq_at : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> forall l', l ⊆ l' -> IEq (c2e G) l' a a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H.
  - (* Var *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Var.
    + eapply lookup_c2e; eauto.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
  - (* Pi *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Pi.
    + eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
  - (* Abs *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Abs. eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
  - (* App *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_App.
    + eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
    + eapply gieq_refl_of. intro Hsub. eapply IHWt2; exact Hsub.
  - (* Conv *) intros l' Hle. eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
  - (* Zero *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Suc. eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
  - (* Ind *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Ind.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt2; eauto.
    + eapply IHWt3; eauto.
    + eapply IHWt4; eauto.
  - (* Nat *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Univ.
  - (* Void *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Absurd.
  - (* Refl *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Eq.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt1; eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt2; eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
  - (* J *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_J.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt6; exact Hle.
    + eapply IHWt4; eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
  - (* Sig *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Sig.
    + eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
  - (* Pack *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Pack.
    + eapply gieq_refl_of. intro Hsub. eapply IHWt1; exact Hsub.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
  - (* Let *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Let.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt3; eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt4; exact Hle.
  - (* TT *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_TT.
  - (* Unit *) intros l' Hle. eapply I_Unit.
  - (* Seq *) intros l' Hle. simpl. eapply I_Seq.
    + eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt1; eapply subset_trans; [eassumption | exact Hle].
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
Qed.
End ex.
EOF

(* Level inclusion is transitive. *)
Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.

  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A context lookup yields a corresponding level lookup in its econtext. *)
Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

(* Generalized equality of a term with itself is decidable via level inclusion. *)
Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),

Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.

Require Export axioms.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Notation fin := nat.

Notation shift := S (only parsing).

Definition var_zero := 0.

Definition id {X} (x: X) := x.

Definition scons {X: Type} (x : X) (xi : nat -> X) :=
  fun n => match n with
          |0 => x
          |S n => xi n
          end.

Notation "s .: sigma" := (scons s sigma) (at level 70).

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1 xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 ->  Y  -> Z.

Class Subst4 (X1 X2 X3 X4: Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5  -> Y  -> Z.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (subst1 sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Class Var X Y :=
  ids : X -> Y.

Arguments funcomp {X Y Z} (g)%fscope (f)%fscope.

Notation "f >> g" := (funcomp g f)   (at level 50) : subst_scope.

Open Scope subst_scope.

Definition up_ren (xi : nat -> nat) :=
  0 .: (xi >> S).

Notation "s '..'" := (scons s ids) (at level 1, format "s ..") : subst_scope.

Notation "↑" := (shift).
=====AXIOMS

Require Import Program.Tactics.

Require Export List.

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Notation "'list_map'" := map.

Definition cod X A:  Type :=  X -> A.

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.

Module consistency
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Level inclusion is transitive. *)
Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A context lookup yields a corresponding level lookup in its econtext. *)
Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

(* Generalized equality of a term with itself is decidable via level inclusion. *)
Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

(* Every well-typed term is IOk in the econtext of its typing context. *)
Lemma wt_iok : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> IOk (c2e G) l a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H.
  - (* Var *) eapply IO_Var; [eapply lookup_c2e; eauto | eauto].
  - (* Pi *) simpl. eapply IO_Pi; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) simpl. eapply IO_Abs; eauto.
  - (* App *) simpl. eapply IO_App; eauto.
  - (* Conv *) exact IHWt1.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) simpl. eapply IO_Suc; eauto.
  - (* Ind *) simpl. eapply IO_Ind; eauto.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) simpl. eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) simpl. eapply IO_Eq; eauto.
  - (* J *) simpl. eapply IO_J; eauto.
  - (* Sig *) simpl. eapply IO_Sig; eauto.
  - (* Pack *) simpl. eapply IO_Pack; eauto.

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).
Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Lemma subset_refl : forall a : T, a ⊆ a.
Proof. intro a. apply meet_idempotent. Qed.

Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* IOk is monotone in its main level. *)
Lemma iok_mono : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a : tm),
  IOk Xi l a -> forall l', l ⊆ l' -> IOk Xi l' a.
Proof.
  intros Xi l a H. induction H; intros l' Hle.
  - eapply IO_Var; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Univ.
  - eapply IO_Pi; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Abs; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_App; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Void.
  - eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - eapply IO_Refl.
  - eapply IO_Eq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_J; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Sig; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Pack; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Let; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Zero.
  - eapply IO_Suc; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Ind; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Nat.
  - eapply IO_Unit.
  - eapply IO_TT.
  - eapply IO_Seq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
Qed.

(* Extending an econtext by a level on both sides preserves iok_ren_ok. *)
Lemma iok_ren_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> fin) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_ren_ok rho Xi D ->
  iok_ren_ok (up_ren rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.
  intros rho Xi D l Hok i ll Hi.
  destruct i as [| k].
  - simpl in Hi. injection Hi as ->. exists l. split.
    + simpl. reflexivity.
    + apply subset_refl.
  - simpl in Hi. destruct (Hok k ll Hi) as [l' [Hlk Hsub]].
    exists l'. split.
    + simpl. exact Hlk.
    + exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* The shift renaming maps one econtext into a context extended by a level. *)
Lemma iok_ren_ok_shift : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_ren_ok shift Xi (l :: Xi).
Proof.
  intros Xi l i ll Hi. exists ll. split.
  - simpl. exact Hi.
  - apply subset_refl.
Qed.

(* IOk is preserved by well-behaved renamings. *)
Lemma iok_ren : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a : tm),
  IOk Xi l a ->
  forall (D : econtext) (rho : fin -> fin),
    iok_ren_ok rho Xi D -> IOk D l (a⟨rho⟩).
Proof.
  intros Xi l a H. induction H; intros D rho Hok; simpl.
  - (* Var *) eapply IO_Var.
    + destruct (Hok i ll H) as [l' [Hlk Hsub]]. exact Hlk.
    + destruct (Hok i ll H) as [l' [Hlk Hsub]].
      eapply subset_trans; [exact Hsub | exact H0].
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Pi *) eapply IO_Pi.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Abs *) eapply IO_Abs. eapply IHiok. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* App *) eapply IO_App.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) eapply IO_Absurd. eapply IHiok. exact Hok.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) eapply IO_Eq.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* J *) eapply IO_J.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Sig *) eapply IO_Sig.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Pack *) eapply IO_Pack.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Let *) eapply IO_Let.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) eapply IO_Suc. eapply IHiok. exact Hok.
  - (* Ind *) eapply IO_Ind.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. apply iok_ren_ok_extend. exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok3; exact Hok.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Unit *) eapply IO_Unit.
  - (* TT *) eapply IO_TT.
  - (* Seq *) eapply IO_Seq.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
Qed.

(* Extending an econtext preserves iok_subst_ok, using the shift renaming. *)
Lemma iok_subst_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> tm) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_subst_ok rho Xi D ->
  iok_subst_ok (up_tm_tm rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.
  intros rho Xi D l Hok i ll Hi.
  destruct i as [| k].
  - simpl in Hi. injection Hi as ->. simpl. eapply IO_Var.
    + simpl. reflexivity.
    + apply subset_refl.
  - simpl in Hi. simpl.
    eapply iok_ren with (Xi := D) (D := l :: D) (rho := shift).
    + apply iok_ren_ok_shift.
    + apply (Hok k ll Hi).
Qed.

(* IOk is preserved by well-behaved substitutions. *)
Lemma iok_subst : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a : tm),
  IOk Xi l a ->
  forall (D : econtext) (rho : fin -> tm),
    iok_subst_ok rho Xi D -> IOk D l (a[rho]).
Proof.
  intros Xi l a H. induction H; intros D rho Hok; simpl.
  - (* Var *) eapply iok_mono.
    + apply (Hok i ll H).
    + exact H0.
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Pi *) eapply IO_Pi.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Abs *) eapply IO_Abs. eapply IHiok. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* App *) eapply IO_App.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) eapply IO_Absurd. eapply IHiok. exact Hok.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) eapply IO_Eq.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* J *) eapply IO_J.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Sig *) eapply IO_Sig.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Pack *) eapply IO_Pack.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
  - (* Let *) eapply IO_Let.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. exact Hok.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) eapply IO_Suc. eapply IHiok. exact Hok.
  - (* Ind *) eapply IO_Ind.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. apply iok_subst_ok_extend. exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok3; exact Hok.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Unit *) eapply IO_Unit.
  - (* TT *) eapply IO_TT.
  - (* Seq *) eapply IO_Seq.
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHiok1; exact Hok.
    + eapply IHiok2; exact Hok.
Qed.
End ex.
EOF

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).
Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Extensionality of renaming. *)
Lemma ren_ext : forall (a : tm) (rho sigma : fin -> fin),
  (forall k, rho k = sigma k) -> ren_tm rho a = ren_tm sigma a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; intros; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - (* tAbs *) f_equal. apply IHa. intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity].
  - (* tApp *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tPi *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity]].
  - (* tAbsurd *) apply IHa; exact H.
  - (* tEq *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tJ *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tSig *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity]].
  - (* tPack *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tLet *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H | apply IHa3; intro k; destruct k as [|[|j]]; simpl; try reflexivity; rewrite H; reflexivity].
  - (* tSuc *) apply IHa; exact H.
  - (* tInd *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k as [|[|j]]; simpl; try reflexivity; rewrite H; reflexivity | apply IHa3; exact H].
  - (* tSeq *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
Qed.

(* Extensionality of substitution. *)
Lemma subst_ext : forall (a : tm) (sigma tau : fin -> tm),
  (forall k, sigma k = tau k) -> subst_tm sigma a = subst_tm tau a.
Proof.
  induction a; simpl; intros; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite H. reflexivity.
  - (* tAbs *) f_equal. apply IHa. intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity].
  - (* tApp *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tPi *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity]].
  - (* tAbsurd *) apply IHa; exact H.
  - (* tEq *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tJ *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tSig *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite H; reflexivity]].
  - (* tPack *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].
  - (* tLet *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H | apply IHa3; intro k; destruct k as [|[|j]]; simpl; try reflexivity; rewrite H; reflexivity].
  - (* tSuc *) apply IHa; exact H.
  - (* tInd *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; intro k; destruct k as [|[|j]]; simpl; try reflexivity; rewrite H; reflexivity | apply IHa3; exact H].
  - (* tSeq *) f_equal; [apply IHa1; exact H | apply IHa2; exact H].

Lemma tm_ren_ren : forall (a : tm) (rho sigma : fin -> fin),
  ren_tm rho (ren_tm sigma a) = ren_tm (sigma >> rho) a.

  - (* tEq *) f_equal; [exact (IHa1 rho sigma) | exact (IHa2 rho sigma)].
  - (* tJ *) f_equal; [exact (IHa1 rho sigma) | exact (IHa2 rho sigma)].
  - (* tSig *) f_equal.
    + exact (IHa1 rho sigma).

Lemma subset_refl : forall a : T, a ⊆ a.
Proof. intro a. apply meet_idempotent. Qed.

Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma iok_mono : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a : tm),
  IOk Xi l a -> forall l', l ⊆ l' -> IOk Xi l' a.
Proof.
  intros Xi l a H. induction H; intros l' Hle.
  - eapply IO_Var; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Univ.
  - eapply IO_Pi; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Abs; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_App; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Void.
  - eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - eapply IO_Refl.
  - eapply IO_Eq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_J; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Sig; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Pack; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Let; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Zero.
  - eapply IO_Suc; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Ind; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - eapply IO_Nat.
  - eapply IO_Unit.
  - eapply IO_TT.
  - eapply IO_Seq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
Qed.

Lemma iok_ren_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> fin) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_ren_ok rho Xi D -> iok_ren_ok (up_ren rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.
  intros rho Xi D l Hok i ll Hi.
  destruct i as [| k].
  - unfold elookup in Hi; simpl in Hi. assert (ll = l) as E by congruence. subst ll. exists l. split; [simpl; reflexivity | apply subset_refl].
  - unfold elookup in Hi; simpl in Hi. destruct (Hok k ll Hi) as [l' [Hlk Hsub]]. exists l'. split; [simpl; exact Hlk | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma iok_ren_ok_shift : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T), iok_ren_ok shift Xi (l :: Xi).
Proof. intros Xi l i ll Hi. exists ll. split; [simpl; exact Hi | apply subset_refl]. Qed.

Lemma iok_ren : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a : tm),

Proof.

  - destruct (Hok i ℓ0 H) as [l' [Hlk Hsub]]. eapply IO_Var; [exact Hlk | eapply subset_trans; [exact Hsub | exact H0]].

  - eapply IO_Sig; eauto 10 using iok_ren_ok_extend, subset_trans.

  - eapply IO_Unit.
  - eapply IO_TT.
  - eapply IO_Seq; eauto 10 using iok_ren_ok_extend, subset_trans.

Lemma iok_subst_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> tm) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_subst_ok rho Xi D -> iok_subst_ok (up_tm_tm rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.

I continued the proof attempt and added another major, fully proved component to `Task.v`, then compiled. The file now gets through all helpers and fails only at the supplied open theorem:

```
File "./Task.v", line 539, characters 0-16:
Error: Command not supported (Open proofs remain)
```

### New in `Task.v` this round (no admits/axioms)

- `conv_sym` — `conv Ξ A B → conv Ξ B A`.
- `conv_refl_ieq` / `conv_refl_typed` — reflexivity of `conv` for `IEq`-equal terms and for every well-typed term.
- `ieq_sym`, `gieq_sym`, `ieq_trans`, `gieq_trans` — `IEq`/`GIEq` are equivalence relations (proved via the supplied `IEq_mutual` scheme).
- **`iok_par`** — `IOk Ξ ℓ a → Par a b → IOk Ξ ℓ b`, i.e. `IOk` is closed under parallel reduction. The β, J, Let and Ind redex cases are handled using the previously proved `iok_subst`, with explicit `iok_subst_ok` witnesses for the substitutions `b1..`, `b1 .: a1 ..`, and `(tInd …) .: c1 ..`; the `Ind` result is lifted with `iok_mono`.

### Remaining obstruction

The target still needs the semantic/canonicity argument. A key observation from this round: `IEq` is *not* closed under `Par` at redexes (e.g. a β-redex is `IEq`-equal to itself but its reduct has a different head), so `conv` is not syntactically transitive without normal forms; the consistency proof cannot be closed by syntactic conversion manipulation alone. It requires the denotational model (codes-with-denotations, conversion-invariance by construction, function-space realizers, and environment irrelevance for the eliminators).

No support files were modified and no proof escapes were used; `Task.v` remains the only edited file.

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.
Module ex (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).
Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Lemma subset_refl : forall a : T, a ⊆ a.
Proof. intro a. apply meet_idempotent. Qed.

Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma iok_ren_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> fin) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  iok_ren_ok rho Xi D -> iok_ren_ok (up_ren rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.
  intros rho Xi D l Hok i ll Hi.

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.

Module consistency
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Level inclusion is transitive. *)
Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A context lookup yields a corresponding level lookup in its econtext. *)
Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

(* Generalized equality of a term with itself is decidable via level inclusion. *)
Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

(* Every well-typed term is IOk in the econtext of its typing context. *)
Lemma wt_iok : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> IOk (c2e G) l a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H.
  - (* Var *) eapply IO_Var; [eapply lookup_c2e; eauto | eauto].
  - (* Pi *) simpl. eapply IO_Pi; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) simpl. eapply IO_Abs; eauto.
  - (* App *) simpl. eapply IO_App; eauto.
  - (* Conv *) exact IHWt1.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) simpl. eapply IO_Suc; eauto.
  - (* Ind *) simpl. eapply IO_Ind; eauto.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) simpl. eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) simpl. eapply IO_Eq; eauto.
  - (* J *) simpl. eapply IO_J; eauto.
  - (* Sig *) simpl. eapply IO_Sig; eauto.
----
  - intros l A IH1 B IH2. simpl. eapply P_Pi; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros n. simpl. eapply P_Univ.
  - simpl. eapply P_Void.
  - intros x IH. simpl. eapply P_Absurd. exact IH.
  - intros l x IH1 y IH2. simpl. eapply P_Eq; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros lp t IH1 p IH2. simpl. destruct p; simpl in *;
      first [ lazymatch goal with
              | |- Par (tJ _ _ tRefl) _ => eapply P_JRefl; exact IH1
              end
            | eapply P_J; [exact IH1 | exact IH2] ].
  - simpl. eapply P_Refl.
  - intros l A IH1 B IH2. simpl. eapply P_Sig; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros l x IH1 y IH2. simpl. eapply P_Pack; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros l0 l1 x IH1 body IH2. simpl. destruct x; simpl in *;
      try (lazymatch goal with
           | |- Par (tLet _ _ (tPack _ _ _) _) _ => fail
           | _ => eapply P_Let; [exact IH1 | exact IH2]
           end).
    destruct (T_eqb t l0) eqn:E.
    + destruct (T_eqdec t l0) as [Heq|Hneq]; [| congruence].
      subst t. inversion IH1; subst. eapply P_LetPack; [assumption | assumption | exact IH2].
    + eapply P_Let; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - simpl. eapply P_Zero.
  - intros x IH. simpl. eapply P_Suc. exact IH.
  - intros l a IH1 b IH2 c IH3. simpl. destruct c; simpl in *;
      first [ lazymatch goal with
              | |- Par (tInd _ _ _ tZero) _ => eapply P_IndZero; exact IH1
              | |- Par (tInd _ _ _ (tSuc _)) _ =>
                  inversion IH3; subst; eapply P_IndSuc; [exact IH1 | exact IH2 | assumption]
              end
            | eapply P_Ind; [exact IH1 | exact IH2 | exact IH3] ].
  - simpl. eapply P_Nat.
  - simpl. eapply P_TT.
  - intros l a IH1 b IH2. simpl. destruct a; simpl in *;
      first [ lazymatch goal with
              | |- Par (tSeq _ tTT _) _ => eapply P_SeqTT; exact IH2
              end
            | eapply P_Seq; [exact IH1 | exact IH2] ].
  - simpl. eapply P_Unit.
Qed.


Lemma T_eqb_refl : forall a : T, T_eqb a a = true.
Proof.
  intro a. destruct (T_eqdec a a) as [H|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dev_app_abs : forall (l0 : T) (body : tm) (l : T) (v : tm),
  dev (tApp (tAbs l0 body) l v) =
  if T_eqb l0 l then subst_tm (scons (dev v) ids) (dev body)
  else tApp (tAbs l0 (dev body)) l (dev v).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_let_pack : forall (l0 l1 l0' : T) (a b body : tm),
  dev (tLet l0 l1 (tPack l0' a b) body) =

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.

Module consistency
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Level inclusion is transitive. *)
Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A context lookup yields a corresponding level lookup in its econtext. *)
Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

(* Generalized equality of a term with itself is decidable via level inclusion. *)
Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

(* Every well-typed term is IOk in the econtext of its typing context. *)
Lemma wt_iok : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> IOk (c2e G) l a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H.
  - (* Var *) eapply IO_Var; [eapply lookup_c2e; eauto | eauto].
  - (* Pi *) simpl. eapply IO_Pi; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) simpl. eapply IO_Abs; eauto.
  - (* App *) simpl. eapply IO_App; eauto.
  - (* Conv *) exact IHWt1.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) simpl. eapply IO_Suc; eauto.
  - (* Ind *) simpl. eapply IO_Ind; eauto.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) simpl. eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) simpl. eapply IO_Eq; eauto.
  - (* J *) simpl. eapply IO_J; eauto.
  - (* Sig *) simpl. eapply IO_Sig; eauto.
----

  - intros n. simpl. eapply P_Univ.
  - simpl. eapply P_Void.
  - intros x IH. simpl. eapply P_Absurd. exact IH.
  - intros l x IH1 y IH2. simpl. eapply P_Eq; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros lp t IH1 p IH2. simpl. destruct p; simpl in *;
      first [ lazymatch goal with
              | |- Par (tJ _ _ tRefl) _ => eapply P_JRefl; exact IH1
              end
            | eapply P_J; [exact IH1 | exact IH2] ].
  - simpl. eapply P_Refl.
  - intros l A IH1 B IH2. simpl. eapply P_Sig; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros l x IH1 y IH2. simpl. eapply P_Pack; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - intros l0 l1 x IH1 body IH2. simpl. destruct x; simpl in *;
      try (lazymatch goal with
           | |- Par (tLet _ _ (tPack _ _ _) _) _ => fail
           | _ => eapply P_Let; [exact IH1 | exact IH2]
           end).
    destruct (T_eqb t l0) eqn:E.
    + destruct (T_eqdec t l0) as [Heq|Hneq]; [| congruence].

    + eapply P_Let; [exact IH1 | exact IH2].
  - simpl. eapply P_Zero.
  - intros x IH. simpl. eapply P_Suc. exact IH.
  - intros l a IH1 b IH2 c IH3. simpl. destruct c; simpl in *;
      first [ lazymatch goal with
              | |- Par (tInd _ _ _ tZero) _ => eapply P_IndZero; exact IH1
              | |- Par (tInd _ _ _ (tSuc _)) _ =>
                  inversion IH3; subst; eapply P_IndSuc; [exact IH1 | exact IH2 | assumption]
              end
            | eapply P_Ind; [exact IH1 | exact IH2 | exact IH3] ].
  - simpl. eapply P_Nat.
  - simpl. eapply P_TT.

              end

Proof.

  IEq Xi l A B -> conv Xi A B.

Require Import imports.

Module Type geq_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Definition econtext := list T.

Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition elookup i Ξ (ℓ : T) := nth_error Ξ i = Some ℓ.

Inductive IOk (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> Prop :=
  | IO_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (var_tm i)
  | IO_Univ i :

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tUniv i)
  | IO_Pi ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A B)
  | IO_Abs ℓ0 a :
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a)
  | IO_App a ℓ0 b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tApp a ℓ0 b)
  | IO_Void :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tVoid
  | IO_Absurd ℓ0 a:
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a)
  | IO_Refl :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tRefl
  | IO_Eq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a b)
  | IO_J ℓp t p :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ t ->
    IOk Ξ ℓp p ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t p)

  | IO_Sig ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A B)

  | IO_Pack ℓ0 a b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a b)

  | IO_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a b :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ1 a ->
    IOk (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a b)

  | IO_Zero :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tZero

  | IO_Suc a :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSuc a)

  | IO_Ind ℓ0 a b c :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ0 b ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 c ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a b c)

  | IO_Nat :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tNat

  | IO_Unit :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tUnit

  | IO_TT :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tTT

  | IO_Seq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a b).

Inductive IEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | I_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (var_tm i) (var_tm i)
  | I_Univ i :

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tUniv i) (tUniv i)
  | I_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ A0 A1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
  | I_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a0) (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
  | I_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
  | I_Void :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tVoid tVoid
  | I_Absurd a b :
    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a) (tAbsurd b)
  | I_Refl :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tRefl tRefl
  | I_Eq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)
  | I_J ℓp t0 t1 p0 p1 :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ t0 t1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ p0 p1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t0 p0) (tJ ℓp t1 p1)
  | I_Sig ℓ0 A0 B0 A1 B1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ A0 A1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A0 B0) (tSig ℓ0 A1 B1)

  | I_Pack ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) (tPack ℓ0 a1 b1)

  | I_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0) (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1)

  | I_Zero :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tZero tZero

  | I_Suc a0 a1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSuc a0) (tSuc a1)

  | I_Ind ℓ0 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ c0 c1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a0 b0 c0) (tInd ℓ0 a1 b1 c1)

  | I_Nat :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tNat tNat

  | I_Unit :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tUnit tUnit

  | I_TT :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tTT tTT

  | I_Seq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tSeq ℓ0 a1 b1)

  with GIEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : T -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | GI_Dist ℓ0 A B :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ A B ->

    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 A B
  | GI_InDist ℓ0 A B :
    ~ (ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ) ->

    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 A B.

Scheme IEq_ind' := Induction for IEq Sort Prop
      with GIEq_ind' := Induction for GIEq Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme IEq_mutual from IEq_ind', GIEq_ind'.

Definition iok_ren_ok ρ Ξ Δ := forall i ℓ, elookup i Ξ ℓ -> exists ℓ0, elookup (ρ i) Δ ℓ0 /\ ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ.

Definition iok_subst_ok ρ Ξ Δ := forall i ℓ, elookup i Ξ ℓ -> IOk Δ ℓ (ρ i).

End geq_sig.

Module Type typing_sig

  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)

  forall i ℓ A, lookup i Γ ℓ A -> exists ℓ0, lookup (ξ i) Δ ℓ0 A⟨ξ⟩ /\ ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ.

  Γ ⊢ tTT ; ℓ ∈ tUnit

  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tUnit ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Seq Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓC a b C i :
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

  (ℓ0, tUnit) :: Γ ⊢ C ; ℓC ∈ tUniv i ->

  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax).

Module Type par_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Reserved Infix "⇒" (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive Par : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| P_Var i :

  (var_tm i) ⇒ (var_tm i)
| P_Univ n :

  (tUniv n) ⇒ (tUniv n)
| P_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) ⇒ (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
| P_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->

  (tAbs ℓ0 a0) ⇒ (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
| P_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
| P_AppAbs a a0 b0 b1 ℓ0 :
  (a ⇒ a0) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp (tAbs ℓ0 a) ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (a0 [b1..])

| P_Void :
  tVoid ⇒ tVoid

| P_Absurd a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tAbsurd a ⇒ tAbsurd b

| P_Refl :

  tRefl ⇒ tRefl

| P_Eq ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) ⇒ (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

| P_J ℓp t0 p0 t1 p1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->
  (p0 ⇒ p1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 p0) ⇒ (tJ ℓp t1 p1)

| P_JRefl ℓp t0 t1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 tRefl) ⇒ t1

  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  tSig ℓ A0 B0 ⇒ tSig ℓ A1 B1

| P_Pack ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tPack ℓ a0 b0) ⇒ (tPack ℓ a1 b1)

| P_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 ⇒ tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1

| P_LetPack ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->
  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) c0 ⇒ c1[b1 .: a1 ..]

| P_Zero :

  tZero ⇒ tZero

| P_Suc a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tSuc a ⇒ tSuc b

| P_Ind ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 c0 ⇒ tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1

| P_IndZero ℓ a0 a1 b:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b tZero ⇒ a1
| P_IndSuc ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 (tSuc c0) ⇒ b1 [(tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1) .: c1  ..]
| P_Nat :

  tNat ⇒ tNat

| P_TT :

  tTT ⇒ tTT

| P_Seq ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ a0 b0 ⇒ tSeq ℓ a1 b1

| P_SeqTT ℓ b0 b1 :
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ tTT b0 ⇒ b1

| P_Unit :

  tUnit ⇒ tUnit

where "A ⇒ B" := (Par A B).

Infix "⇒*" := (rtc Par) (at level 60, right associativity).

End par_sig.
