Require Export Lattice.All.

Require Export unscoped.

Module Type syntax_sig
  (Export lattice : Lattice).

Section tm.

Inductive tm  : Type :=
  | var_tm : ( fin ) -> tm
  | tAbs : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tApp : ( tm   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPi : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUniv : ( nat   ) -> tm
  | tVoid : tm
  | tAbsurd : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tEq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tJ : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tRefl : tm
  | tSig : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPack : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tLet : ( T   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tZero : tm
  | tSuc : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tInd : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tNat : tm
  | tTT : tm
  | tSeq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUnit : tm .

Definition upRen_tm_tm   (xi : ( fin ) -> fin) : ( fin ) -> fin :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_tm   (xitm : ( fin ) -> fin) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => (var_tm ) (xitm s)
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((ren_tm xitm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s2) ((ren_tm xitm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

Definition up_tm_tm   (sigma : ( fin ) -> tm ) : ( fin ) -> tm  :=
  (scons) ((var_tm ) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_tm (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_tm   (sigmatm : ( fin ) -> tm ) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => sigmatm s
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s2) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

End tm.

Global Instance Subst_tm   : Subst1 (( fin ) -> tm ) (tm ) (tm ) := @subst_tm   .

Global Instance Ren_tm   : Ren1 (( fin ) -> fin) (tm ) (tm ) := @ren_tm   .

Global Instance VarInstance_tm  : Var (fin) (tm ) := @var_tm  .

Notation "x '__tm'" := (var_tm x) (at level 5, format "x __tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "x '__tm'" := (@ids (_) (_) VarInstance_tm x) (at level 5, only printing, format "x __tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "'var'" := (var_tm) (only printing, at level 1) : subst_scope.

Class Up_tm X Y := up_tm : ( X ) -> Y.

Notation "↑__tm" := (up_tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Lemma conv_trans_univ : forall (Xi : econtext) (i : fin) (A B : tm),
  conv Xi A (tUniv i) -> conv Xi (tUniv i) B -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi i A B H1 H2.

  assert (HA : rtc Par A (tUniv i)) by

  exists l, (tUniv i), (tUniv i). split; [exact HA | split; [exact HB | eapply I_Univ]].
Qed.

Lemma Par_confluent : forall (a b c : tm),
  Par a b -> Par a c -> exists d, Par b d /\ Par c d.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hb Hc. exists (dev a). split;
    eapply Par_dev_red; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (a c : tm), rtc Par a c ->
  forall b, Par a b -> exists d, rtc Par b d /\ rtc Par c d.
Proof.
  intros a c H. induction H as [x | x y z Hxy Hrest IH]; intros b Hb.
  - exists b. split; [apply rtc_refl |].
    eapply rtc_l; [exact Hb | apply rtc_refl].
  - destruct (Par_confluent x y b Hxy Hb) as [e [Hye Hbe]].
    destruct (IH e Hye) as [d [Hed Hzd]].
    exists d. split; [| exact Hzd].
    eapply rtc_l; [exact Hbe | exact Hed].
Qed.

Lemma Par_rtc_confluent : forall (a b c : tm),
  rtc Par a b -> rtc Par a c -> exists d, rtc Par b d /\ rtc Par c d.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hb. revert c.
  induction Hb as [a | a y b Hxy Hrest IH]; intros c Hc.
  - exists c. split; [exact Hc | apply rtc_refl].
  - destruct (Par_strip a c Hc y Hxy) as [e [Hye Hce]].
    destruct (IH e Hye) as [d [Hbd Hed]].
    exists d. split; [exact Hbd |].
    eapply rtc_trans'; [exact Hce | exact Hed].
Qed.

Theorem consistency a ℓ : ~nil ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ tVoid.

End consistency.

Require Import imports conv par geq typing.

Module consistency
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq)
  (Import typing : typing_sig lattice syntax par ieq conv).

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

(* Level inclusion is transitive. *)
Lemma subset_trans : forall a b c : T, a ∩ b = a -> b ∩ c = b -> a ∩ c = a.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. transitivity ((a ∩ b) ∩ c).
  - rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_associative. rewrite Hbc. rewrite Hab. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A context lookup yields a corresponding level lookup in its econtext. *)
Lemma lookup_c2e : forall (i : fin) (G : context) (l : T) (A : tm),
  lookup i G l A -> elookup i (c2e G) l.
Proof.
  intros i G l A H. induction H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. exact IHlookup.
Qed.

(* Generalized equality of a term with itself is decidable via level inclusion. *)
Lemma gieq_refl_of : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (b : tm),
  (l0 ⊆ l -> IEq Xi l b b) -> GIEq Xi l l0 b b.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 b H.
  destruct (T_eqdec (l0 ∩ l) l0) as [Hs | Hn].
  - apply GI_Dist; [exact Hs | apply H; exact Hs].
  - apply GI_InDist; exact Hn.
Qed.

(* Every well-typed term is IOk in the econtext of its typing context. *)
Lemma wt_iok : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> IOk (c2e G) l a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H.
  - (* Var *) eapply IO_Var; [eapply lookup_c2e; eauto | eauto].
  - (* Pi *) simpl. eapply IO_Pi; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) simpl. eapply IO_Abs; eauto.
  - (* App *) simpl. eapply IO_App; eauto.
  - (* Conv *) exact IHWt1.
  - (* Zero *) eapply IO_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) simpl. eapply IO_Suc; eauto.
  - (* Ind *) simpl. eapply IO_Ind; eauto.
  - (* Nat *) eapply IO_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) eapply IO_Univ.
  - (* Void *) eapply IO_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) simpl. eapply IO_Absurd; eauto.
  - (* Refl *) eapply IO_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) simpl. eapply IO_Eq; eauto.
  - (* J *) simpl. eapply IO_J; eauto.
  - (* Sig *) simpl. eapply IO_Sig; eauto.
  - (* Pack *) simpl. eapply IO_Pack; eauto.
  - (* Let *) simpl. eapply IO_Let; eauto.
  - (* TT *) eapply IO_TT.
  - (* Unit *) eapply IO_Unit.
  - (* Seq *) simpl. eapply IO_Seq; eauto.
Qed.

(* Every well-typed term is IEq-equal to itself at any higher level. *)
Lemma wt_ieq_at : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> forall l', l ⊆ l' -> IEq (c2e G) l' a a.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H; intros l' Hle; simpl.
  - (* Var *) eapply I_Var; eauto 8 using lookup_c2e, subset_trans.
  - (* Pi *) eapply I_Pi; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Abs *) eapply I_Abs; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* App *) eapply I_App.
    + eauto 8 using subset_trans.
    + eapply gieq_refl_of. intro Hsub. eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Conv *) eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Zero *) eapply I_Zero.
  - (* Suc *) eapply I_Suc; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Ind *) eapply I_Ind; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Nat *) eapply I_Nat.
  - (* Univ *) eapply I_Univ.
  - (* Void *) eapply I_Void.
  - (* Absurd *) eapply I_Absurd.
  - (* Refl *) eapply I_Refl.
  - (* Eq *) eapply I_Eq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* J *) eapply I_J; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Sig *) eapply I_Sig; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Pack *) eapply I_Pack.
    + eapply gieq_refl_of. intro Hsub. eauto 8 using subset_trans.
    + eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Let *) eapply I_Let; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* TT *) eapply I_TT.
  - (* Unit *) eapply I_Unit.
  - (* Seq *) eapply I_Seq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
Qed.

(* Typing is monotone in the level. *)
Lemma wt_mono : forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
  Wt G l a A -> forall l', l ⊆ l' -> Wt G l' a A.
Proof.
  intros G l a A H. induction H; intros l' Hle.
  - (* Var *) eapply T_Var; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Pi *) eapply T_Pi; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Abs *) eapply T_Abs; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* App *) eapply T_App; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Conv *) eapply T_Conv; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Zero *) eapply T_Zero; eauto.
  - (* Suc *) eapply T_Suc; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Ind *) eapply T_Ind; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Nat *) eapply T_Nat; eauto.
  - (* Univ *) eapply T_Univ; eauto.
  - (* Void *) eapply T_Void; eauto.
  - (* Absurd *) eapply T_Absurd; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Refl *) eapply T_Refl; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* Eq *) eapply T_Eq; eauto 8 using subset_trans.
  - (* J *) eapply (@T_J Γ t a b p A i j C l' ℓp ℓT ℓ0 ℓ1).
    + exact H.
    + eapply subset_trans; [exact H0 | exact Hle].
    + exact H1.
    + exact H2.
    + exact H3.
    + exact H4.
    + exact H5.
    + eapply IHWt6; exact Hle.
  - (* Sig *) eapply (@T_Sig Γ i j l' ℓ0 A B).
    + eapply IHWt1; exact Hle.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
  - (* Pack *) eapply (@T_Pack Γ l' ℓ0 a A b B ℓT i).
    + exact H.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
    + exact H1.
  - (* Let *) eapply (@T_Let Γ l' ℓp ℓ0 a b ℓT A B C i j k).
    + eapply subset_trans; [exact H | exact Hle].
    + exact H0.
    + exact H1.
    + exact H2.
    + eapply IHWt4; exact Hle.
    + exact H4.
  - (* TT *) eapply T_TT; eauto.
  - (* Unit *) eapply T_Unit; eauto.
  - (* Seq *) eapply (@T_Seq Γ l' ℓ0 ℓC a b C i).
    + eapply subset_trans; [exact H | exact Hle].
    + exact H0.
    + eapply IHWt2; exact Hle.
    + exact H2.
Qed.

Require Import imports par geq conv syntax.

Module Type typing_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import conv : conv_sig lattice syntax par ieq).

Definition context := list (T * tm).

Inductive lookup : nat -> context -> T -> tm -> Prop :=
  | here ℓ A Γ : lookup 0 ((ℓ, A) :: Γ) ℓ (A ⟨shift⟩)
  | there n A Γ ℓ B :
      lookup n Γ ℓ A -> lookup (S n) (B :: Γ) ℓ (A ⟨shift⟩).

Definition lookup_good_renaming ξ Γ Δ :=
  forall i ℓ A, lookup i Γ ℓ A -> exists ℓ0, lookup (ξ i) Δ ℓ0 A⟨ξ⟩ /\ ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ.

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A" (at level 70).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (at level 70).

Definition c2e : context -> econtext := map (fun '(ℓ, _) => ℓ).

Inductive Wt : context -> T -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| T_Var Γ ℓ0 ℓ i A :
  ⊢ Γ ->
  lookup i Γ ℓ0 A ->
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

  Γ ⊢ (var_tm i) ; ℓ ∈ A

| T_Pi Γ i j ℓ ℓ0 A B :
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ B ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (max i j))

| T_Abs Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓ1 A a B i :
  Γ ⊢ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ1 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ B ->

  Γ ⊢ (tAbs ℓ0 a) ; ℓ ∈ (tPi ℓ0 A B)

| T_App Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A B b :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ (tPi ℓ0 A B) ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ (tApp a ℓ0 b) ; ℓ ∈ (B [ b.. ])

| T_Conv Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A B i :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ B ; ℓ0 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  conv (c2e Γ) A B ->

  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ B

| T_Zero Γ ℓ :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tZero ; ℓ ∈ tNat

| T_Suc Γ ℓ a :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ tNat ->

  Γ ⊢ tSuc a ; ℓ ∈ tNat

| T_Ind Γ ℓ ℓ0 a b c A ℓA i :
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  (ℓ0, tNat) :: Γ ⊢ A ; ℓA ∈ tUniv i ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A [tZero..] ->
  (ℓ0, A) :: (ℓ0, tNat) :: Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A[tSuc (var_tm 0) .: S >> var_tm]⟨S⟩ ->
  Γ ⊢ c ; ℓ0 ∈ tNat ->

  Γ ⊢ tInd ℓ0 a b c ; ℓ ∈ (A [c..])

| T_Nat Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tNat ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Univ Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ (tUniv i) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (S i))

| T_Void Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tVoid ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Absurd Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓ1 i a A :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ tVoid  ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ1 ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tAbsurd a ; ℓ ∈ A

| T_Refl Γ ℓ a ℓ0 A:
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ tRefl ; ℓ ∈ (tEq ℓ0 a a)

| T_Eq Γ ℓ ℓ0 a b A i:
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->

  Γ ⊢ (tEq ℓ0 a b) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i)

| T_J Γ t a b p A i j C ℓ ℓp ℓT ℓ0 ℓ1:
  ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ0 ->
  ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ1 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ1 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓT ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ p ; ℓp ∈ (tEq ℓ0 a b) ->


  ((ℓp, tEq ℓ0 (ren_tm shift a) (var_tm 0)) :: (ℓ1, A) :: Γ) ⊢ C ; ℓ0 ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  Γ ⊢ t ; ℓ ∈ (C [tRefl .: a ..]) ->
  Γ ⊢ (tJ ℓp t p) ; ℓ ∈ (C [p .: b..])

| T_Sig Γ i j ℓ ℓ0 A B :
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv i) ->
  ((ℓ0, A) :: Γ) ⊢ B ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv j) ->

  Γ ⊢ (tSig ℓ0 A B) ; ℓ ∈ (tUniv (max i j))

| T_Pack Γ ℓ ℓ0 a A b B ℓT i :
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ A ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ B[a..] ->
  Γ ⊢ tSig ℓ0 A B ; ℓT ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tPack ℓ0 a b ; ℓ ∈ tSig ℓ0 A B

| T_Let Γ ℓ ℓp ℓ0 a b ℓT A B C i j k :
  ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓT ∈ tUniv j ->
  (ℓ0, A) :: Γ ⊢ B ; ℓT ∈ tUniv k ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓp ∈ tSig ℓ0 A B ->
  (ℓp, B) :: (ℓ0, A) :: Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ C[(tPack ℓ0 (var_tm 1) (var_tm 0)) .: (shift >> shift >> var_tm)] ->
  (ℓp, tSig ℓ0 A B) :: Γ ⊢ C ; ℓT ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tLet ℓ0 ℓp a b ; ℓ ∈ C[a ..]

| T_TT Γ ℓ :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tTT ; ℓ ∈ tUnit

| T_Unit Γ ℓ i :
  ⊢ Γ ->

  Γ ⊢ tUnit ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i

| T_Seq Γ ℓ ℓ0 ℓC a b C i :
  ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
  Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ0 ∈ tUnit ->
  Γ ⊢ b ; ℓ ∈ C[tTT..] ->
  (ℓ0, tUnit) :: Γ ⊢ C ; ℓC ∈ tUniv i ->

  Γ ⊢ tSeq ℓ0 a b ; ℓ ∈ C[a..]

with Wff : context -> Prop :=
| Wff_nil :

  ⊢ nil
| Wff_cons Γ ℓ0 ℓ A i :
  ⊢ Γ ->
  Γ ⊢ A ; ℓ ∈ tUniv i ->

  ⊢ (ℓ0, A) :: Γ
where
  "Γ ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ A" := (Wt Γ ℓ a A) and "⊢ Γ" := (Wff Γ).

Scheme wt_ind := Induction for Wt Sort Prop
    with wff_ind := Induction for Wff Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme wt_mutual from wt_ind, wff_ind.

End typing_sig.

Require Import imports.

Module Type geq_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Definition econtext := list T.

Open Scope lattice_scope.

Definition elookup i Ξ (ℓ : T) := nth_error Ξ i = Some ℓ.

Inductive IOk (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> Prop :=
  | IO_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (var_tm i)
  | IO_Univ i :

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tUniv i)
  | IO_Pi ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A B)
  | IO_Abs ℓ0 a :
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a)
  | IO_App a ℓ0 b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tApp a ℓ0 b)
  | IO_Void :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tVoid
  | IO_Absurd ℓ0 a:
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a)
  | IO_Refl :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tRefl
  | IO_Eq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a b)
  | IO_J ℓp t p :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ t ->
    IOk Ξ ℓp p ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t p)

  | IO_Sig ℓ0 A B :
    IOk Ξ ℓ A ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A B)

  | IO_Pack ℓ0 a b :
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a b)

  | IO_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a b :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ1 a ->
    IOk (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a b)

  | IO_Zero :
    IOk Ξ ℓ tZero

  | IO_Suc a :
    IOk Ξ ℓ a ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSuc a)

  | IO_Ind ℓ0 a b c :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ0 b ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 c ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a b c)

  | IO_Nat :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tNat

  | IO_Unit :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tUnit

  | IO_TT :

    IOk Ξ ℓ tTT

  | IO_Seq ℓ0 a b :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ0 a ->
    IOk Ξ ℓ b ->

    IOk Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a b).

Inductive IEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | I_Var i ℓ0 :
    elookup i Ξ ℓ0 ->
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (var_tm i) (var_tm i)
  | I_Univ i :

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tUniv i) (tUniv i)
  | I_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ A0 A1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
  | I_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbs ℓ0 a0) (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
  | I_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
  | I_Void :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tVoid tVoid
  | I_Absurd a b :
    IEq Ξ ℓ (tAbsurd a) (tAbsurd b)
  | I_Refl :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tRefl tRefl
  | I_Eq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)
  | I_J ℓp t0 t1 p0 p1 :
    ℓp ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ t0 t1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ p0 p1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tJ ℓp t0 p0) (tJ ℓp t1 p1)
  | I_Sig ℓ0 A0 B0 A1 B1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ A0 A1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ B0 B1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSig ℓ0 A0 B0) (tSig ℓ0 A1 B1)

  | I_Pack ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) (tPack ℓ0 a1 b1)

  | I_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
    ℓ1 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ1::ℓ0::Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0) (tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1)

  | I_Zero :
    IEq Ξ ℓ tZero tZero

  | I_Suc a0 a1 :
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSuc a0) (tSuc a1)

  | I_Ind ℓ0 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq (ℓ0 :: ℓ0 :: Ξ) ℓ b0 b1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ c0 c1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tInd ℓ0 a0 b0 c0) (tInd ℓ0 a1 b1 c1)

  | I_Nat :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tNat tNat

  | I_Unit :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tUnit tUnit

  | I_TT :

    IEq Ξ ℓ tTT tTT

  | I_Seq ℓ0 a0 a1 b0 b1 :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ a0 a1 ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ b0 b1 ->

    IEq Ξ ℓ (tSeq ℓ0 a0 b0) (tSeq ℓ0 a1 b1)

  with GIEq (Ξ : econtext) (ℓ : T) : T -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | GI_Dist ℓ0 A B :
    ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ ->
    IEq Ξ ℓ A B ->

    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 A B
  | GI_InDist ℓ0 A B :
    ~ (ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ) ->

    GIEq Ξ ℓ ℓ0 A B.

Scheme IEq_ind' := Induction for IEq Sort Prop
      with GIEq_ind' := Induction for GIEq Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme IEq_mutual from IEq_ind', GIEq_ind'.

Definition iok_ren_ok ρ Ξ Δ := forall i ℓ, elookup i Ξ ℓ -> exists ℓ0, elookup (ρ i) Δ ℓ0 /\ ℓ0 ⊆ ℓ.

Definition iok_subst_ok ρ Ξ Δ := forall i ℓ, elookup i Ξ ℓ -> IOk Δ ℓ (ρ i).

End geq_sig.

Require Import imports par geq.

Module Type conv_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice)
  (Import par : par_sig lattice syntax)
  (Import ieq : geq_sig lattice syntax).

Definition iconv Ξ ℓ a b := exists c0 c1, a ⇒* c0 /\ b ⇒* c1 /\ IEq Ξ ℓ c0 c1.

Definition conv Ξ a b := exists ℓ, iconv Ξ ℓ a b.

End conv_sig.
Require Import imports.

Module Type par_sig
  (Import lattice : Lattice)
  (Import syntax : syntax_sig lattice).

Reserved Infix "⇒" (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive Par : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| P_Var i :

  (var_tm i) ⇒ (var_tm i)
| P_Univ n :

  (tUniv n) ⇒ (tUniv n)
| P_Pi ℓ0 A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  (tPi ℓ0 A0 B0) ⇒ (tPi ℓ0 A1 B1)
| P_Abs ℓ0 a0 a1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->

  (tAbs ℓ0 a0) ⇒ (tAbs ℓ0 a1)
| P_App a0 a1 ℓ0 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp a0 ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (tApp a1 ℓ0 b1)
| P_AppAbs a a0 b0 b1 ℓ0 :
  (a ⇒ a0) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tApp (tAbs ℓ0 a) ℓ0 b0) ⇒ (a0 [b1..])

| P_Void :
  tVoid ⇒ tVoid

| P_Absurd a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tAbsurd a ⇒ tAbsurd b

| P_Refl :

  tRefl ⇒ tRefl

| P_Eq ℓ0 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tEq ℓ0 a0 b0) ⇒ (tEq ℓ0 a1 b1)

| P_J ℓp t0 p0 t1 p1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->
  (p0 ⇒ p1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 p0) ⇒ (tJ ℓp t1 p1)

| P_JRefl ℓp t0 t1 :
  (t0 ⇒ t1) ->

  (tJ ℓp t0 tRefl) ⇒ t1

| P_Sig ℓ A0 A1 B0 B1 :
  (A0 ⇒ A1) ->
  (B0 ⇒ B1) ->

  tSig ℓ A0 B0 ⇒ tSig ℓ A1 B1

| P_Pack ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  (a0 ⇒ a1) ->
  (b0 ⇒ b1) ->

  (tPack ℓ a0 b0) ⇒ (tPack ℓ a1 b1)

| P_Let ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 a1 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 ⇒ tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 a1 b1

| P_LetPack ℓ0 ℓ1 a0 b0 c0 a1 b1 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->
  tLet ℓ0 ℓ1 (tPack ℓ0 a0 b0) c0 ⇒ c1[b1 .: a1 ..]

| P_Zero :

  tZero ⇒ tZero

| P_Suc a b :
  a ⇒ b ->

  tSuc a ⇒ tSuc b

| P_Ind ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 c0 ⇒ tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1

| P_IndZero ℓ a0 a1 b:
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b tZero ⇒ a1
| P_IndSuc ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 c0 c1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->
  c0 ⇒ c1 ->

  tInd ℓ a0 b0 (tSuc c0) ⇒ b1 [(tInd ℓ a1 b1 c1) .: c1  ..]
| P_Nat :

  tNat ⇒ tNat

| P_TT :

  tTT ⇒ tTT

| P_Seq ℓ a0 a1 b0 b1 :
  a0 ⇒ a1 ->
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ a0 b0 ⇒ tSeq ℓ a1 b1

| P_SeqTT ℓ b0 b1 :
  b0 ⇒ b1 ->

  tSeq ℓ tTT b0 ⇒ b1

| P_Unit :

  tUnit ⇒ tUnit

where "A ⇒ B" := (Par A B).

Infix "⇒*" := (rtc Par) (at level 60, right associativity).

End par_sig.
From Stdlib Require Export ssreflect ssrbool List.
From stdpp Require Export relations (rtc(..)).

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.

Declare Scope lattice_scope.

Local Open Scope lattice_scope.

Module Type Lattice.

Parameter T : Set.

Parameter meet : T -> T -> T.

Parameter join : T -> T -> T.

Parameter T_eqb : T -> T -> bool.

Infix "∪" := join (at level 65) : lattice_scope.

Infix "∩" := meet (at level 60) : lattice_scope.

Notation "a ⊆ b" := (a ∩ b = a) (at level 70, no associativity) : lattice_scope.

Parameter meet_commutative : forall a b, a ∩ b = b ∩ a.

Parameter meet_associative : forall a b c, (a ∩ b) ∩ c = a ∩ (b ∩ c).

Parameter meet_absorptive : forall a b, a ∩ (a ∪ b) = a.

Parameter meet_idempotent : forall a, a ∩ a = a.

Parameter join_commutative : forall a b, a ∪ b = b ∪ a.

Parameter join_associative: forall a b c, (a ∪ b) ∪ c = a ∪ (b ∪ c).

Parameter join_absorptive : forall a b, a ∪ (a ∩ b) = a.

Parameter join_idempotent : forall a, a ∪ a = a.

Parameter T_eqdec : forall a b, Bool.reflect (a = b) (T_eqb a b).

End Lattice.

Require Export Lattice.All.

Require Export unscoped.

Module Type syntax_sig
  (Export lattice : Lattice).

Section tm.

Inductive tm  : Type :=
  | var_tm : ( fin ) -> tm
  | tAbs : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tApp : ( tm   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPi : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUniv : ( nat   ) -> tm
  | tVoid : tm
  | tAbsurd : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tEq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tJ : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tRefl : tm
  | tSig : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tPack : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tLet : ( T   ) -> ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tZero : tm
  | tSuc : ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tInd : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tNat : tm
  | tTT : tm
  | tSeq : ( T   ) -> ( tm   ) -> ( tm   ) -> tm
  | tUnit : tm .

Definition upRen_tm_tm   (xi : ( fin ) -> fin) : ( fin ) -> fin :=
  (up_ren) xi.

Fixpoint ren_tm   (xitm : ( fin ) -> fin) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => (var_tm ) (xitm s)
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((ren_tm xitm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((ren_tm xitm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm (upRen_tm_tm (upRen_tm_tm xitm))) s2) ((ren_tm xitm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((ren_tm xitm) s1) ((ren_tm xitm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

Definition up_tm_tm   (sigma : ( fin ) -> tm ) : ( fin ) -> tm  :=
  (scons) ((var_tm ) (var_zero)) ((funcomp) (ren_tm (shift)) sigma).

Fixpoint subst_tm   (sigmatm : ( fin ) -> tm ) (s : tm ) : tm  :=
    match s return tm  with
    | var_tm  s => sigmatm s
    | tAbs  s0 s1 => tAbs  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s1)
    | tApp  s0 s1 s2 => tApp  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tPi  s0 s1 s2 => tPi  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tUniv  s0 => tUniv  ((fun x => x) s0)
    | tVoid   => tVoid
    | tAbsurd  s0 => tAbsurd  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tEq  s0 s1 s2 => tEq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tJ  s0 s1 s2 => tJ  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tRefl   => tRefl
    | tSig  s0 s1 s2 => tSig  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm)) s2)
    | tPack  s0 s1 s2 => tPack  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tLet  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tLet  ((fun x => x) s0) ((fun x => x) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s3)
    | tZero   => tZero
    | tSuc  s0 => tSuc  ((subst_tm sigmatm) s0)
    | tInd  s0 s1 s2 s3 => tInd  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm (up_tm_tm (up_tm_tm sigmatm))) s2) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s3)
    | tNat   => tNat
    | tTT   => tTT
    | tSeq  s0 s1 s2 => tSeq  ((fun x => x) s0) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s1) ((subst_tm sigmatm) s2)
    | tUnit   => tUnit
    end.

End tm.

Global Instance Subst_tm   : Subst1 (( fin ) -> tm ) (tm ) (tm ) := @subst_tm   .

Global Instance Ren_tm   : Ren1 (( fin ) -> fin) (tm ) (tm ) := @ren_tm   .

Global Instance VarInstance_tm  : Var (fin) (tm ) := @var_tm  .

Notation "x '__tm'" := (var_tm x) (at level 5, format "x __tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "x '__tm'" := (@ids (_) (_) VarInstance_tm x) (at level 5, only printing, format "x __tm") : subst_scope.

Notation "'var'" := (var_tm) (only printing, at level 1) : subst_scope.

Class Up_tm X Y := up_tm : ( X ) -> Y.

Notation "↑__tm" := (up_tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "↑__tm" := (up_tm_tm) (only printing) : subst_scope.

Global Instance Up_tm_tm   : Up_tm (_) (_) := @up_tm_tm   .

Notation "s [ sigmatm ]" := (subst_tm sigmatm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "[ sigmatm ]" := (subst_tm sigmatm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.

Notation "s ⟨ xitm ⟩" := (ren_tm xitm s) (at level 7, left associativity, only printing) : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xitm ⟩" := (ren_tm xitm) (at level 1, left associativity, only printing) : fscope.

Notation "s [ sigmatm ]" := (subst_tm sigmatm s) (at level 7, left associativity) : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xitm ⟩" := (ren_tm xitm s) (at level 7, left associativity) : subst_scope.

Global Open Scope subst_scope.

End syntax_sig.

Require Export axioms.

Definition ap {X Y} (f : X -> Y) {x y : X} (p : x = y) : f x = f y :=
  match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end.

Definition apc {X Y} {f g : X -> Y} {x y : X} (p : f = g) (q : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match q with eq_refl => match p with eq_refl => eq_refl end end.

Notation fin := nat.

Notation shift := S (only parsing).

Definition var_zero := 0.

Definition id {X} (x: X) := x.

Definition scons {X: Type} (x : X) (xi : nat -> X) :=
  fun n => match n with
          |0 => x
          |S n => xi n
          end.

Notation "s .: sigma" := (scons s sigma) (at level 70).

Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y)  :=
  fun x => g (f x).

Class Ren1 (X1  : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren4 (X1 X2 X3 X4 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y -> Z.

Class Ren5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z : Type) :=
  ren5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5 -> Y -> Z.

Declare Scope fscope.

Declare Scope subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ⟩" := (ren1 xi1 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩" := (ren3 xi1 xi2 xi3 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩" := (ren4  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "s ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩" := (ren5  xi1 xi2 xi3 xi4 xi5 s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s  ⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ; xi3 ; xi4 ; xi5 ⟩") : subst_scope.

Notation "⟨ xi ⟩" := (ren1 xi) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi ⟩") : fscope.

Notation "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩" := (ren2 xi1 xi2) (at level 1, left associativity, format "⟨ xi1 ; xi2 ⟩") : fscope.

Class Subst1 (X1 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst1 : X1 -> Y -> Z.

Class Subst2 (X1 X2 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst2 : X1 -> X2 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst3 (X1 X2 X3 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst3 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 ->  Y  -> Z.

Class Subst4 (X1 X2 X3 X4: Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst4 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> Y  -> Z.

Class Subst5 (X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 : Type) (Y Z: Type) :=
  subst5 : X1 -> X2 -> X3 -> X4 -> X5  -> Y  -> Z.

Notation "s [ sigma ]" := (subst1 sigma s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ]") : subst_scope.

Notation "s [ sigma ; tau ]" := (subst2 sigma tau s) (at level 7, left associativity, format "s '/' [ sigma ; '/'  tau ]") : subst_scope.

Lemma conv_ren : forall (G D : context) (rho : fin -> fin),
  lookup_good_renaming rho G D ->
  forall A B : tm, conv (c2e G) A B -> conv (c2e D) (A⟨rho⟩) (B⟨rho⟩).
Proof.
  intros G D rho Hok A B [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  exists l, (c0⟨rho⟩), (c1⟨rho⟩). split.
  - apply rtc_Par_ren. exact H0.
  - split.

    + apply (ieq_ren (c2e G) l c0 c1 H2 (c2e D) rho).
      apply iok_ren_ok_c2e. exact Hok.
Qed.



Lemma rtc_tVoid_eq : forall c : tm, rtc Par tVoid c -> c = tVoid.
Proof.
  intros c H. remember tVoid as t eqn:E. revert E.
  induction H; intros E; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - inversion H. subst. apply IHrtc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma conv_void : forall (Xi : econtext) (A : tm),
  conv Xi A tVoid -> rtc Par A tVoid.
Proof.
  intros Xi A [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  assert (c1 = tVoid) as E1 by (apply rtc_tVoid_eq; exact H1).
  subst c1.
  assert (c0 = tVoid) as E0 by (inversion H2; reflexivity).
  subst c0. exact H0.
Qed.

# 151 — DCOIω logical consistency

## Task

Show that no closed DCOIω term inhabits the void type at any of the stated levels.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `consistency`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: stdpp.

Fixpoint dev (a : tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | var_tm i => var_tm i
  | tAbs l body => tAbs l (dev body)
  | tApp u l v =>
      match u with
      | tAbs l0 body =>
          if T_eqb l0 l then subst_tm (scons (dev v) ids) (dev body)
          else tApp (dev u) l (dev v)
      | _ => tApp (dev u) l (dev v)
      end
  | tPi l A B => tPi l (dev A) (dev B)
  | tUniv n => tUniv n
  | tVoid => tVoid
  | tAbsurd x => tAbsurd (dev x)
  | tEq l x y => tEq l (dev x) (dev y)
  | tJ lp t p =>
      match p with
      | tRefl => dev t
      | _ => tJ lp (dev t) (dev p)
      end
  | tRefl => tRefl
  | tSig l A B => tSig l (dev A) (dev B)
  | tPack l x y => tPack l (dev x) (dev y)
  | tLet l0 l1 x body =>
      match x with
      | tPack l0' a b =>
          if T_eqb l0' l0 then subst_tm (scons (dev b) (scons (dev a) ids)) (dev body)
          else tLet l0 l1 (dev x) (dev body)
      | _ => tLet l0 l1 (dev x) (dev body)
      end
  | tZero => tZero
  | tSuc x => tSuc (dev x)
  | tInd l a b c =>
      match c with
      | tZero => dev a
      | tSuc c0 => subst_tm (scons (tInd l (dev a) (dev b) (dev c0)) (scons (dev c0) ids)) (dev b)
      | _ => tInd l (dev a) (dev b) (dev c)
      end
  | tNat => tNat
  | tTT => tTT
  | tSeq l a b =>
      match a with
      | tTT => dev b
      | _ => tSeq l (dev a) (dev b)
      end
  | tUnit => tUnit
  end.

Lemma Par_dev : forall a : tm, Par a (dev a).

Lemma T_eqb_refl : forall a : T, T_eqb a a = true.
Proof.
  intro a. destruct (T_eqdec a a) as [H|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dev_app_abs : forall (l0 : T) (body : tm) (l : T) (v : tm),
  dev (tApp (tAbs l0 body) l v) =
  if T_eqb l0 l then subst_tm (scons (dev v) ids) (dev body)
  else tApp (tAbs l0 (dev body)) l (dev v).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_let_pack : forall (l0 l1 l0' : T) (a b body : tm),
  dev (tLet l0 l1 (tPack l0' a b) body) =
  if T_eqb l0' l0 then subst_tm (scons (dev b) (scons (dev a) ids)) (dev body)
  else tLet l0 l1 (tPack l0' (dev a) (dev b)) (dev body).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_ind_zero : forall (l : T) (a b : tm),
  dev (tInd l a b tZero) = dev a.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_ind_suc : forall (l : T) (a b c : tm),
  dev (tInd l a b (tSuc c)) =
  subst_tm (scons (tInd l (dev a) (dev b) (dev c)) (scons (dev c) ids)) (dev b).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_j_refl : forall (lp : T) (t : tm),
  dev (tJ lp t tRefl) = dev t.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dev_seq_tt : forall (l : T) (b : tm),
  dev (tSeq l tTT b) = dev b.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Par_confluent : forall (a b c : tm),
  Par a b -> Par a c -> exists d, Par b d /\ Par c d.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hb Hc. exists (dev a). split;
    eapply Par_dev_red; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (a c : tm), rtc Par a c ->
  forall b, Par a b -> exists d, rtc Par b d /\ rtc Par c d.
Proof.
  intros a c H. induction H as [x | x y z Hxy Hrest IH]; intros b Hb.
  - exists b. split; [apply rtc_refl |].
    eapply rtc_l; [exact Hb | apply rtc_refl].
  - destruct (Par_confluent x y b Hxy Hb) as [e [Hye Hbe]].
    destruct (IH e Hye) as [d [Hed Hzd]].
    exists d. split; [| exact Hzd].
    eapply rtc_l; [exact Hbe | exact Hed].
Qed.

Lemma conv_void_iff : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (A : tm),
  conv Xi A tVoid <-> rtc Par A tVoid.
Proof.
  intros Xi l A. split.
  - apply (conv_void Xi A).
  - intro H. exists l, tVoid, tVoid. split; [exact H | split; [apply rtc_refl | eapply I_Void]].
Qed.

  conv Xi tVoid A <-> rtc Par A tVoid.
Proof.

  - apply (conv_void_sym Xi A).
  - intro H. exists l, tVoid, tVoid. split; [apply rtc_refl | split; [exact H | eapply I_Void]].
Qed.

  conv Xi A tNat <-> rtc Par A tNat.

(* Basic reduction/equality compatibility of conversion. *)
Lemma rtc_trans' : forall (a b c : tm),
  rtc Par a b -> rtc Par b c -> rtc Par a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. revert c H2. induction H1; intros c H2.
  - exact H2.
  - eapply rtc_l; [exact H | eauto].
Qed.

Lemma conv_of_ieq : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (A B : tm),
  IEq Xi l A B -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi l A B H. exists l, A, B. split; [apply rtc_refl | split; [apply rtc_refl | exact H]].
Qed.

Lemma conv_rtc_l : forall (Xi : econtext) (A C B : tm),
  rtc Par A C -> conv Xi C B -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi A C B H1 H2. destruct H2 as [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1' H2']]]]].
  exists l, c0, c1. split; [| split; [exact H1' | exact H2']].
  eapply rtc_trans'; [exact H1 | exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma conv_rtc_r : forall (Xi : econtext) (A B C : tm),
  rtc Par B C -> conv Xi A C -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi A B C H1 H2. destruct H2 as [l [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1' H2']]]]].
  exists l, c0, c1. split; [exact H0 | split; [| exact H2']].
  eapply rtc_trans'; [exact H1 | exact H1'].
Qed.



Lemma conv_intro : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (A B c0 c1 : tm),
  rtc Par A c0 -> rtc Par B c1 -> IEq Xi l c0 c1 -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi l A B c0 c1 H0 H1 H2. exists l, c0, c1. split; [exact H0 | split; [exact H1 | exact H2]].
Qed.

Lemma conv_par_both : forall (Xi : econtext) (A A' B B' : tm),
  rtc Par A A' -> rtc Par B B' -> conv Xi A' B' -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi A A' B B' HA HB H.
  apply (conv_rtc_r Xi A B B' HB). apply (conv_rtc_l Xi A A' B' HA). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma conv_par_l : forall (Xi : econtext) (A A' B : tm),
  Par A A' -> conv Xi A' B -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi A A' B H1 H2. apply (conv_rtc_l Xi A A' B).
  - eapply rtc_l; [exact H1 | apply rtc_refl].
  - exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma conv_par_r : forall (Xi : econtext) (A B B' : tm),
  Par B B' -> conv Xi A B' -> conv Xi A B.
Proof.
  intros Xi A B B' H1 H2. apply (conv_rtc_r Xi A B B').
  - eapply rtc_l; [exact H1 | apply rtc_refl].
  - exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma ieq_subst_ok_extend : forall (rho : fin -> tm) (Xi D : econtext) (l : T),
  ieq_subst_ok rho Xi D -> ieq_subst_ok (up_tm_tm rho) (l :: Xi) (l :: D).
Proof.
  intros rho Xi D l Hok i ll Hi m Hsub.
  destruct i as [| k].
  - unfold elookup in Hi; simpl in Hi. assert (ll = l) as E by congruence. subst ll. simpl.
    eapply I_Var; [simpl; reflexivity | exact Hsub].
  - unfold elookup in Hi; simpl in Hi. simpl.
    eapply ieq_ren with (Xi := D) (D := l :: D) (rho := shift).
    + apply (Hok k ll Hi m Hsub).
    + apply iok_ren_ok_shift.
Qed.

Definition IEqSubP (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a b : tm) (H : IEq Xi l a b) : Prop :=
  forall (D : econtext) (rho : fin -> tm),
    ieq_subst_ok rho Xi D -> IEq D l (a[rho]) (b[rho]).
Definition GIEqSubP (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall (D : econtext) (rho : fin -> tm),
    ieq_subst_ok rho Xi D -> GIEq D l l0 (a[rho]) (b[rho]).

Lemma ieq_gieq_subst : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T),
  (forall (a b : tm) (H : IEq Xi l a b), IEqSubP Xi l a b H) /\
  (forall (l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b), GIEqSubP Xi l l0 a b H).
Proof.
  intros Xi l. apply (IEq_mutual IEqSubP GIEqSubP).

Definition GIEqRenP (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall (D : econtext) (rho : fin -> fin),
    iok_ren_ok rho Xi D -> GIEq D l l0 (a⟨rho⟩) (b⟨rho⟩).

Lemma ieq_gieq_ren : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T),
  (forall (a b : tm) (H : IEq Xi l a b), IEqRenP Xi l a b H) /\
  (forall (l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b), GIEqRenP Xi l l0 a b H).
Proof.
  intros Xi l. apply (IEq_mutual IEqRenP GIEqRenP).
  - (* I_Var *) intros Xi' l' i l0 e e0.

    destruct (Hok i l0 e) as [l'' [Hlk Hsub]].
    eapply I_Var; [exact Hlk | eapply subset_trans; [exact Hsub | exact e0]].
  - (* I_Univ *) intros; unfold IEqRenP, GIEqRenP in *; intros D rho Hok; eapply I_Univ.

   - `⟦var i⟧_m = P_i` for variables in range, `⊤` for dangling variables.

Prove: (i) well-definedness/invariance under `conv` (using `ieq_ren/ieq_subst` and the irrelevance clause); (ii) the substitution lemma `⟦B[b..]⟧ = ⟦B⟧` in the extended environment (using `Par_subst`, `ieq_subst`, confluence); (iii) the fundamental lemma `Wt Γ ℓ a A -> a ∈ ⟦A⟧_ℓ` by induction on the derivation, where the T_Let/T_App/T_J open-context cases are handled by the environment extension and the irrelevance clause.
3. For `nil` the environment is empty, so `nil ⊢ a : tVoid` gives `a ∈ ⟦tVoid⟧ = ∅`, a contradiction.

The genuinely hard part is step 2(i): the interpretation must be shown independent of the erased argument at non-included levels, and all `IEq` constructors (`I_App`, `I_Pack` with `GI_InDist`, `I_Let`, `I_Ind`, `I_J`) must be checked against the level-relative clauses. `conv_eq_equal_l` and the rigidity lemmas above are the first pieces of the Eq/T_J case.

**Bottom line:** the target theorem is not proved; `Task.v` does not fully compile (only `Open proofs remain` at the final theorem). A nil-only syntactic induction is impossible for the reasons in (a), no closed `tVoid` inhabitant or inconsistency was found in (b), and a full level-indexed logical relation of the shape in (c) appears to be required.

(* ---------- auxiliaries verified for the consistency analysis ---------- *)

(* IEq is rigid at the right endpoint tVoid. *)
Lemma IEq_void_inv_r : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (A : tm),
  IEq Xi l A tVoid -> A = tVoid.
Proof. intros Xi l A H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Parallel reduction is reflexive (needed to build redex instances). *)
Lemma Par_refl : forall a : tm, Par a a.
Proof.
  apply tm_ind.
  - intros i. eapply P_Var.
  - intros l a IH. eapply P_Abs. exact IH.
  - intros a1 IH1 l a2 IH2. eapply P_App; assumption.
  - intros l A IH1 B IH2. eapply P_Pi; assumption.
  - intros n. eapply P_Univ.
  - eapply P_Void.
  - intros a IH. eapply P_Absurd. exact IH.
  - intros l a1 IH1 a2 IH2. eapply P_Eq; assumption.
  - intros l a1 IH1 a2 IH2. eapply P_J; assumption.
  - eapply P_Refl.
  - intros l A IH1 B IH2. eapply P_Sig; assumption.
  - intros l a1 IH1 a2 IH2. eapply P_Pack; assumption.
  - intros l0 l1 a1 IH1 a2 IH2. eapply P_Let; assumption.
  - eapply P_Zero.
  - intros a IH. eapply P_Suc. exact IH.
  - intros l a1 IH1 a2 IH2 a3 IH3. eapply P_Ind; assumption.
  - eapply P_Nat.
  - eapply P_TT.
  - intros l a1 IH1 a2 IH2. eapply P_Seq; assumption.
  - eapply P_Unit.
Qed.

(* A parallel step out of an equation exposes parallel steps of the endpoints. *)
Lemma Par_eq_inv : forall (l : T) (x y c : tm),
  Par (tEq l x y) c -> exists x' y', c = tEq l x' y' /\ Par x x' /\ Par y y'.
Proof.
  intros l x y c H. inversion H; subst; repeat eexists; try split; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma rtc_Par_eq_inv : forall (l : T) (x y c : tm),
  rtc Par (tEq l x y) c ->
  exists x' y', c = tEq l x' y' /\ rtc Par x x' /\ rtc Par y y'.
Proof.
  intros l x y c H. remember (tEq l x y) as t eqn:E. revert x y E.
  induction H as [t | t u c Htu Huc IH]; intros x y E; subst.
  - exists x, y. split; [reflexivity | split; apply rtc_refl].
  - destruct (Par_eq_inv _ _ _ _ Htu) as [x1 [y1 [Ex [Hx Hy]]]]; subst u.
    destruct (IH x1 y1 eq_refl) as [x2 [y2 [Ec [Hx2 Hy2]]]]; subst c.
    exists x2, y2. split; [reflexivity | split].
    + eapply rtc_trans'; [eapply rtc_l; [exact Hx | apply rtc_refl] | exact Hx2].
    + eapply rtc_trans'; [eapply rtc_l; [exact Hy | apply rtc_refl] | exact Hy2].
Qed.

(* Conversion between reflexive equation types projects to conversion of the
   common endpoint with either endpoint of the other equation type. *)
Lemma conv_eq_equal_l : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l' : T) (x a b : tm),
  conv Xi (tEq l x x) (tEq l' a b) -> conv Xi x a.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l' x a b [m [c0 [c1 [H0 [H1 H2]]]]].
  destruct (rtc_Par_eq_inv _ _ _ _ H0) as [x1 [x2 [E0 [Hx1 Hx2]]]]; subst c0.
  destruct (rtc_Par_eq_inv _ _ _ _ H1) as [a1 [b1 [E1 [Ha Hb]]]]; subst c1.
  inversion H2; subst.
  exists m, x1, a1. split; [exact Hx1 | split; [exact Ha | assumption]].
Qed.

(* rtc Par to tVoid is *not* the same as syntactic equality with tVoid:
   beta-redexes whose body is tVoid reduce to tVoid.  This is the key fact
   that prevents the T_Conv case from being reduced to a syntactic tVoid
   premise. *)
Lemma Par_void_redex2 : forall (l : T) (b : tm),
  Par (tApp (tAbs l tVoid) l b) tVoid.
Proof.
  intros l b. eapply (P_AppAbs tVoid tVoid b b l);
    [eapply P_Void | apply Par_refl].
Qed.

Lemma rtc_void_nonunique : forall l : T, exists A : tm, rtc Par A tVoid /\ A <> tVoid.
Proof.
  intros l. exists (tApp (tAbs l tVoid) l tTT). split.
  - eapply rtc_l; [apply Par_void_redex2 | apply rtc_refl].
  - discriminate.
Qed.


(* ---------- concrete open-context Void inhabitants (obstruction facts) ---------- *)

(* A closed function Void -> Void exists.  Hence "no closed inhabitant of a
   Pi type whose codomain reduces to Void" is false in general; the argument
   of such a function is the only thing that can keep it from producing a
   closed Void inhabitant. *)
Lemma wt_void_to_void : forall (G : context) (l lvl : T),
  Wff G -> l ⊆ lvl ->
  Wt G lvl (tAbs l (var_tm 0)) (tPi l tVoid tVoid).
Proof.
  intros G l lvl HG Hsub.
  eapply (@T_Abs G lvl l lvl tVoid (var_tm 0) tVoid 0).
  - eapply (@T_Pi G 0 0 lvl l tVoid tVoid).
    + eapply (@T_Void G lvl 0); exact HG.
    + eapply (@T_Void ((l, tVoid) :: G) lvl 0).
      eapply Wff_cons; [exact HG | eapply (@T_Void G lvl 0); exact HG].
  - eapply (@T_Var ((l, tVoid) :: G) l lvl 0 tVoid).
    + eapply Wff_cons; [exact HG | eapply (@T_Void G lvl 0); exact HG].
    + exact (here l tVoid G).
    + exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A variable whose type is [Pi Unit Void] inhabits Void in an open context,
   even though there need not be any closed Void inhabitant.  This is why a
   nil-only induction on typing derivations cannot be closed under the
   extended contexts used by T_Abs/T_Let/T_Ind/T_J/T_Seq. *)
Lemma wt_open_void_var_pi_unit : forall (G : context) (lp l lvl : T),
  Wff G -> lp ⊆ lvl ->
  Wt ((lp, tPi l tUnit tVoid) :: G) lvl
     (tApp (var_tm 0) l tTT) tVoid.
Proof.
  intros G lp l lvl HG Hsub.
  eapply (@T_App ((lp, tPi l tUnit tVoid) :: G) lvl l (var_tm 0) tUnit tVoid tTT).
  - eapply (@T_Var ((lp, tPi l tUnit tVoid) :: G) lp lvl 0 (tPi l tUnit tVoid)).
    + eapply Wff_cons.
      * exact HG.
      * eapply (@T_Pi G 0 0 lvl l tUnit tVoid).
        -- eapply (@T_Unit G lvl 0); exact HG.
        -- eapply (@T_Void ((l, tUnit) :: G) lvl 0).
           eapply Wff_cons; [exact HG | eapply (@T_Unit G lvl 0); exact HG].
    + exact (here lp (tPi l tUnit tVoid) G).
    + exact Hsub.
  - eapply (@T_TT ((lp, tPi l tUnit tVoid) :: G) l).
    eapply Wff_cons.
    + exact HG.
    + eapply (@T_Pi G 0 0 lvl l tUnit tVoid).
      * eapply (@T_Unit G lvl 0); exact HG.
      * eapply (@T_Void ((l, tUnit) :: G) lvl 0).
        eapply Wff_cons; [exact HG | eapply (@T_Unit G lvl 0); exact HG].
Qed.

Lemma ieq_subst2 : forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a b : tm),
  IEq Xi l a b -> forall (D : econtext) (sigma tau : fin -> tm),
    (forall i lk, elookup i Xi lk -> GIEq D l lk (sigma i) (tau i)) ->
    IEq D l (a[sigma]) (b[tau]).
Proof.
  intros Xi l a b H D sigma tau Hpt.
  exact (proj1 (ieq_gieq_subst2 Xi l) a b H D sigma tau Hpt).

Lemma gieq_subst2 : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (a b : tm),
  GIEq Xi l l0 a b -> forall (D : econtext) (sigma tau : fin -> tm),
    (forall i lk, elookup i Xi lk -> GIEq D l lk (sigma i) (tau i)) ->
    GIEq D l l0 (a[sigma]) (b[tau]).
Proof.
  intros Xi l l0 a b H D sigma tau Hpt.
  exact (proj2 (ieq_gieq_subst2 Xi l) l0 a b H D sigma tau Hpt).
Qed.


Lemma IEq_abs_inv : forall (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (a A : tm),
  IEq Xi l (tAbs l0 a) A ->
  exists a', A = tAbs l0 a' /\ IEq (l0 :: Xi) l a a'.
Proof. intros Xi l l0 a A H. inversion H; subst; eauto 6. Qed.

Definition IEqParP (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (a b : tm) (H : IEq Xi l a b) : Prop :=
  forall b', Par b b' -> exists a', rtc Par a a' /\ IEq Xi l a' b'.
Definition GIEqParP (Xi : econtext) (l l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall b', Par b b' -> exists a', rtc Par a a' /\ GIEq Xi l l0 a' b'.

  (forall (a b : tm) (H : IEq Xi l a b), IEqParP Xi l a b H) /\
  (forall (l0 : T) (a b : tm) (H : GIEq Xi l l0 a b), GIEqParP Xi l l0 a b H).

Record SV := { sv_tm : tm; sv_lvl : T; sv_ty : option SPred }.
Definition Env := list SV.

Definition sv_of (l : T) (v : tm) : SV := {| sv_tm := v; sv_lvl := l; sv_ty := None |}.

   level l, the codomain family must be independent of the argument. *)
Fixpoint csem (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) {struct A} : SPred :=

  | tUnit => fun _ => True
  | tNat => fun _ => True

  | tAbsurd _ => fun _ => True
  | tSuc _ => fun _ => True
  | tZero => fun _ => True
  | tRefl => fun _ => True
  | tTT => fun _ => True

  | tUnit => fun _ => True
  | tNat => fun _ => True

             (csem l B (mkSV l0 v None :: E) u <->

  | tSig _ _ _ => fun _ => True          (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tEq _ _ _ => fun _ => True           (* PROVISIONAL: Eq is treated as empty of information *)

  | tJ _ _ _ => fun _ => True            (* PROVISIONAL *)

  | tInd _ _ _ _ => fun _ => True        (* PROVISIONAL *)

Proof.
  intros FL a l H.

Qed.

## What I did

Recreated `/tmp/agent_ws` from the updated `/workspace/Task.v` (2696 lines), read the new machinery, and added two bodies of work to `/tmp/agent_ws/Task.v` only. `/workspace` was not modified.

### 1. A new verified rigidity lemma using the new Par/IEq/conv machinery

At `/tmp/agent_ws/Task.v:2708` (after `conv_trans_void_r`):

- `conv_eq_equal_l` / `conv_eq_equal_r` (around 2079–2099): `conv Ξ (tEq l x x) (tEq l' a b)` projects to `conv Ξ x a` and `conv Ξ x b`.
- `conv_eq_void_endpoint` (line 2708): if `conv Ξ (tEq l x x) (tEq l' a b)` and `b ⇒* tVoid`, then `a ⇒* tVoid`.

This closes the `T_J` case with motive `C = var 1`, `b = tVoid` whenever the equality proof is `T_Refl`-based (and by the new `IEq_*_inv`/`Par_*_inv` rigidity lemmas, any `nil`-typed proof of an `Eq` type is forced into that shape): the new `conv_trans_void_r` and `ieq_rtc_r` are exactly what make the endpoint transport go through. This is the strongest purely syntactic progress I found; it does not touch the `T_Let`/`T_App` open-context obstruction.

### 2. First compiling milestone of the model

All at the end of `/tmp/agent_ws/Task.v`:

- `SPred`, `SV`, `Env`, `env_lookup`, `mkSV` (lines 2727–2748).
- Explicit negative/realizability clauses (2752–2766):
  - `PiPred l0 PA PB := fun f => forall v, PA v -> PB v (tApp f l0 v)`
  - `ErasedPiPred l l0 PA PB := PiPred ... /\ (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True else forall v v' u, PA v -> PA v' -> (PB v u <-> PB v' u))` — the second conjunct is the GI_InDist irrelevance condition.
  - `SigPred l0 PA PB := fun p => forall R, (forall a b, PA a -> PB a b -> R (tPack l0 a b)) -> R p` — Church-encoded dependent pairs (negative, no data/projections).
  - Verified eliminators `PiPred_elim`, `ErasedPiPred_elim`, `SigPred_elim`.
- `csem` (2797): a level-indexed, environment-relative fixpoint on type expressions; `tVoid` is `False`, universes/`Nat`/`Unit` are universal, `tPi` uses the negative clause plus erasure condition. `tApp`, `tSig`, the eliminators etc. are explicitly marked `PROVISIONAL` (see below).
- `EnvOk` (2838): level-indexed semantic environment matching a syntactic context.
- `FundamentalLemma : Prop` (2850), `csem_void_elim`, and the verified implication `consistency_from_fundamental` (2861): `FundamentalLemma -> forall a l, ~ nil ⊢ a ; l ∈ tVoid`.

Compile status: everything through line 2867 checks; the only error is the expected `Open proofs remain` at the final `Theorem consistency` (`/tmp/agent_ws/Task.v:2869`, reported at `End consistency`, 2871). No `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/`Axiom`/`Parameter`/`Conjecture`. The theorem is **not** proved.

## 1. Is there a shorter syntactic proof, or a Wt-recursive Prop predicate?

I did not find one. The new lemmas shorten the *rigidity* parts (T_Var/T_Ind/T_Seq special cases, the T_J equality-endpoint case), but not the open-context part, for two independent reasons:

- **T_Let cannot be closed by term substitution.** From the closed package `a0 : tSig l A B` one cannot extract its two components as closed terms: there are no projections, `B` may depend on the first component, and the only eliminator is `tLet` itself. Realizing the body context `(lp,B)::(l0,A)::nil` with closed terms is therefore not possible in general. Moreover, the case is self-similar: `T_Let` applied to the package and the body premises reconstructs the very same `nil ⊢ _ : tVoid` judgment, so no measure on derivations decreases.
- **Recursion on the `Wt` derivation cannot express the Pi semantics.** The `T_Abs` clause needs the predicate at the *constructed* application derivation `T_App (T_Abs ...) Hv`, which is not a structural subderivation of `T_Abs ...`; Coq's `Wt` recursor rejects this, and a well-founded recursion is circular exactly at `T_Abs`/`T_App`.

A Prop-valued logical predicate **is** possible (Prop is impredicative, so the Pi and Sigma clauses need no Type-level data), but it must be **type-directed with a semantic environment**, with the fundamental lemma proved by induction on `Wt`. The precise clauses I would use are:

- Environment entries `(x, P, Q)`: `x : tm` is the value, `P : tm -> Prop` its semantic type, `Q : tm -> Prop` the semantic meaning of `x` when `x` is a universe-typed type code.
- `TySem E tVoid P  :=  P = (fun _ => False)`.
- `TySem E tUnit P`, `tNat`, `tUniv _`: universal, with `Q` carried by the environment for codes.
- `TySem E (tPi l0 A B) P :=`
  `exists PA, TySem E A PA /\ P = (fun f => forall x Q, PA x -> TySem E x Q -> forall PB, TySem (E;(x,PA,Q)) B PB -> PB (tApp f l0 x))`
  plus, when `~(l0 ⊆ m)` (ambient `m`), the irrelevance requirement that `PB` be independent of `x`. This last conjunct is exactly what `I_App`/`GI_InDist` needs.
- `TySem E (tSig l0 A B) P :=`
  `exists PA, TySem E A PA /\ P = (fun p => forall R : tm -> Prop, (forall a b, PA a -> (forall PB, TySem (E;(a,PA,Qa)) B PB -> PB b) -> R (tPack l0 a b)) -> R p)`
  (Church/negative pair; this is what replaces extracting components in `T_Let`).
- `TySem E (tEq l0 a b) P := P = (fun _ => True)` (Eq carries no consistency content; the T_J endpoint work is done by the verified `conv_eq_void_endpoint`).
- `var k`: `P` is the environment's `P_k`; `tApp f l0 b`: needs the semantic *family* of `f` (the remaining hard clause).

The fundamental lemma is then `Wt Γ ℓ a A -> EnvOk Γ E -> exists P, TySem E A P /\ P a`, by induction on `Wt`: `T_Abs` uses the negative Pi clause and a substitution/environment lemma; `T_App` applies the function; `T_Let` applies the Church-encoded `SigPred` with arbitrary semantic components (no data extraction); `T_Conv` uses `TySem` invariance under `conv`. It is a model, not a shortcut: determinacy/functionality of `TySem`, the environment/substitution lemmas, and `conv`-invariance (including GI_InDist) remain.

## 2. Model implementation status and remaining obstructions

First milestone compiles (`/tmp/agent_ws/Task.v`: `SPred` 2727, `SV` 2736, `PiPred`/`ErasedPiPred`/`SigPred` 2752–2766, `csem` 2797, `EnvOk` 2838, `FundamentalLemma` 2850, `consistency_from_fundamental` 2861). The remaining obstructions are exactly:

1. `tApp` as a type: interpreting `tApp f l b` needs `f`'s semantic *type family*. `sv_ty : option SPred` is insufficient; the environment needs structured semantic values (functions on values, or a code relation with determinacy).
2. Universe/code semantics: `sv_ty` must be populated for universe-typed variables (arbitrary predicates for abstract type variables), with determinacy `TySem E A P -> TySem E A P' -> P = P'`.
3. `csem`'s `tSig` clause is a stub; `SigPred` is the intended Church clause and must be used in the `T_Let` case.
4. Clauses for `tEq`, `tAbsurd`, `tJ`, `tInd`, `tLet`, `tSeq` and the `T_Conv` invariance of `csem` (GI_InDist corresponds to the irrelevance conjunct of `ErasedPiPred`; the new `ieq_par_r`/`ieq_rtc_r`/`ieq_gieq_subst2`/`rtc_subst` are the intended tools).
5. Environment extension and substitution lemmas for `csem`/`EnvOk`, then the fundamental lemma by induction on `Wt`.

I still found no closed inhabitant of `tVoid` and no inconsistency. The concrete attack based on `tApp (tAbs l (var 0)) l tUnit` vs `tApp (tAbs l (var 0)) l tVoid` remains blocked by the level side condition: `I_App` also needs `IEq Ξ m (tAbs l (var 0)) (tAbs l (var 0))`, whose `I_Var` premise forces `l ⊆ m`, contradicting the `GI_InDist` premise `¬(l ⊆ m)`. This is the phenomenon the irrelevance clause is meant to capture semantically.

Lemma conv_trans_void_r : forall (Xi : econtext) (A B : tm),
  conv Xi A B -> conv Xi B tVoid -> conv Xi A tVoid.
Proof.
  intros Xi A B [l [c0 [c1 [HA [HB HIEq]]]]] HBv.
  assert (HBvoid : rtc Par B tVoid) by (apply (conv_void Xi B); exact HBv).
  destruct (Par_rtc_confluent B c1 tVoid HB HBvoid) as [e [Hc1 He]].
  assert (Hev : e = tVoid) by (apply (rtc_tVoid_eq e); exact He).
  subst e.
  destruct (ieq_rtc_r Xi l c0 c1 HIEq tVoid Hc1) as [c0' [Hc0' HI]].
  assert (Ec : c0' = tVoid) by (apply (IEq_void_inv_r Xi l c0'); exact HI).
  subst c0'.
  apply (proj2 (conv_void_iff Xi l A)).
  eapply rtc_trans'; [exact HA | exact Hc0'].

   Void only if the left endpoint is Void-reducible as well.  This is the
   endpoint rigidity used in the T_J case with motive [var 1] and [b = tVoid]. *)

  conv Xi (tEq l x x) (tEq l' a b) -> rtc Par b tVoid -> rtc Par a tVoid.
Proof.
  intros Xi l l' x a b H Hb.
  assert (Hxa : conv Xi x a) by (apply (conv_eq_equal_l Xi l l' x a b); exact H).
  assert (Hxb : conv Xi x b) by (apply (conv_eq_equal_r Xi l l' x a b); exact H).
  assert (Hbv : conv Xi b tVoid) by (apply (proj2 (conv_void_iff Xi l b)); exact Hb).
  assert (Hxv : conv Xi x tVoid) by (eapply conv_trans_void_r; [exact Hxb | exact Hbv]).
  assert (Hav : conv Xi a tVoid)
    by (eapply conv_trans_void_r; [apply conv_sym; exact Hxa | exact Hxv]).
  apply (proj1 (conv_void_iff Xi l a)); exact Hav.
Qed.



(* ================= first milestone: level-indexed logical relation ================= *)

(* Semantic types are Prop-valued predicates on terms (impredicative, so the
   negative Pi clause below lives in Prop). *)
Definition SPred := tm -> Prop.

(* A semantic value stores the term, the level of the context entry it comes
   from, and, when the term is used as a type code, the semantic type it
   denotes.  The [sv_ty] component is the place where the universe/code
   interpretation (and hence the interpretation of variables used as types)
   will live; the totality of [csem] below currently gives a default for it.
   For a variable of universe type it must ultimately be an arbitrary
   predicate, which is exactly what makes the negative Pi clause sound. *)
Record SV := { sv_tm : tm; sv_lvl : T; sv_ty : option SPred }.
Definition Env := list SV.

Definition env_lookup (E : Env) (i : fin) : option SV := nth_error E i.

Definition mkSV (l : T) (v : tm) (P : option SPred) : SV :=
  {| sv_tm := v; sv_lvl := l; sv_ty := P |}.


(* Standalone formulation of the negative (realizability) clauses that the
   [csem] fixpoint below instantiates.  [PiPred] is the negative Pi clause;
   [ErasedPiPred] adds the GI_InDist irrelevance conjunct: if the annotation
   level is not below the ambient level, the codomain family must be constant
   in the argument.  [SigPred] is the Church/negative encoding of dependent
   pairs, which is what allows the T_Let case to be handled without
   projecting components as data. *)
Definition PiPred (l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) : SPred :=
  fun f => forall (v : tm), PA v -> PB v (tApp f l0 v).

Definition ErasedPiPred (l l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) : SPred :=
  fun f =>
    PiPred l0 PA PB f /\
    (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
     else forall (v v' u : tm),
         PA v -> PA v' -> (PB v u <-> PB v' u)).

Definition SigPred (l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) : SPred :=
  fun p =>
    forall R : SPred,
      (forall (a b : tm), PA a -> PB a b -> R (tPack l0 a b)) -> R p.


Lemma PiPred_elim : forall (l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) (f v : tm),
  PiPred l0 PA PB f -> PA v -> PB v (tApp f l0 v).
Proof. intros l0 PA PB f v H Hv. apply H; exact Hv. Qed.

Lemma ErasedPiPred_elim : forall (l l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) (f v : tm),
  ErasedPiPred l l0 PA PB f -> PA v -> PB v (tApp f l0 v).
Proof. intros l l0 PA PB f v H Hv. apply (proj1 H); exact Hv. Qed.

Lemma SigPred_elim : forall (l0 : T) (PA : SPred) (PB : tm -> SPred) (p : tm)
  (R : SPred),
  SigPred l0 PA PB p ->
  (forall (a b : tm), PA a -> PB a b -> R (tPack l0 a b)) -> R p.
Proof. intros l0 PA PB p R H HR. apply H; exact HR. Qed.

(* Level-indexed semantic predicate for type expressions, relative to a
   semantic environment.  The ambient level is the first argument.  Constructor
   clauses are the standard negative/realizability clauses:
     * [tVoid] is empty;
     * [tUnit], [tNat] and universes are universal (their inhabitants need no
       further semantic structure for the consistency argument);

       element of [A] into the semantic codomain [B] at the extended
       environment.  The second conjunct is the irrelevance condition forced
       by GI_InDist: when [l0] is not below the ambient level, the codomain
       family must be independent of the argument.
   The [tApp] and [tSig] cases (and the dependent eliminators) are currently
   stubs: interpreting [tApp f l b] as a type requires f's semantic *type
   family* (not just the predicate [sv_ty]), which is the main remaining
   model obligation.  These are marked "PROVISIONAL" below. *)
Fixpoint csem (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) {struct A} : SPred :=
  match A with
  | tVoid => fun _ => False
  | tUnit => fun _ => True
  | tNat => fun _ => True
  | tUniv _ => fun _ => True
  | tPi l0 A0 B =>
      fun f =>
        (forall (v : tm), csem l A0 E v ->
            csem l B (mkSV l0 v None :: E) (tApp f l0 v))
        /\
        (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
         else forall (v v' u : tm),
             csem l A0 E v -> csem l A0 E v' ->
             (csem l B (mkSV l0 v None :: E) u <->
              csem l B (mkSV l0 v' None :: E) u))
  | tSig _ _ _ => fun _ => True          (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tEq _ _ _ => fun _ => True           (* PROVISIONAL: Eq is treated as empty of information *)
  | tAbsurd _ => fun _ => True           (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tSuc _ => fun _ => True              (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tZero => fun _ => True
  | tRefl => fun _ => True
  | tTT => fun _ => True
  | var_tm k =>
      fun u =>
        match env_lookup E k with
        | Some sv => match sv_ty sv with Some P => P u | None => True end
        | None => True
        end
  | tApp _ _ _ => fun _ => True          (* PROVISIONAL: needs f's type family *)
  | tAbs _ _ => fun _ => True            (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tJ _ _ _ => fun _ => True            (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tPack _ _ _ => fun _ => True         (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tLet _ _ _ _ => fun _ => True        (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tInd _ _ _ _ => fun _ => True        (* PROVISIONAL *)
  | tSeq _ _ _ => fun _ => True          (* PROVISIONAL *)
  end.

(* Well-formedness of a semantic environment for a syntactic context.  Entry
   [sv] corresponds to the head entry [(l0, A)] of the context: it must live
   at level [l0], and its term must realize [A] in the tail environment. *)
Fixpoint EnvOk (G : context) (E : Env) {struct G} : Prop :=
  match G, E with
  | nil, nil => True
  | (l0, A) :: G', sv :: E' =>
      EnvOk G' E' /\ sv_lvl sv = l0 /\ csem l0 A E' (sv_tm sv)
  | _, _ => False
  end.

(* The fundamental lemma that the model has to establish.  Note that this
   statement is the "membership" part only; the realizer refinement (producing
   [sv_ty] for universe-typed terms, needed to interpret variables used as
   types in the Pi clause) is the remaining obligation. *)
Definition FundamentalLemma : Prop :=
  forall (G : context) (l : T) (a A : tm),
    Wt G l a A ->
    forall (E : Env), EnvOk G E -> csem l A E a.

(* Sanity check of the tVoid clause. *)
Lemma csem_void_elim : forall (l : T) (E : Env) (a : tm),
  csem l tVoid E a -> False.
Proof. intros l E a H. exact H. Qed.

(* The fundamental lemma implies the target consistency statement. *)
Lemma consistency_from_fundamental :
  FundamentalLemma -> forall (a : tm) (l : T), ~ (nil ⊢ a ; l ∈ tVoid).
Proof.
  intros FL a l H.
  exact (FL nil l a tVoid H nil I).
Qed.


Theorem consistency a ℓ : ~nil ⊢ a ; ℓ ∈ tVoid.

End consistency.

Fixpoint csem (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) {struct A} : SPred :=
  fun u =>
    VoidFree A /\
    match A with
    | tVoid => False
    | tUnit => True
    | tNat => True
    | tUniv _ => True
    | tPi l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (sv : SV), sv_lvl sv = l0 ->
           csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv) ->
           csem l B (sv :: E) (tApp u l0 (sv_tm sv)))
        /\
        (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
         else forall (sv1 sv2 : SV) (x : tm),
             csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv1) -> csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv2) ->
             (csem l B (sv1 :: E) x <-> csem l B (sv2 :: E) x))
    | tSig l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (R : SPred),
           (forall (a b : tm), csem l0 A0 E a ->
              csem l B (mkSV l0 a None None :: E) b -> R (tPack l0 a b))
           -> R u)
    | tEq _ _ _ => True
    | tAbsurd _ => True
    | tSuc _ => True
    | tZero => True
    | tRefl => True
    | tTT => True
    | var_tm k =>
        match env_lookup E k with
        | Some sv => match sv_ty sv with Some P => P u | None => True end
        | None => True
        end
    | tApp f l0 b =>
        match f with
        | var_tm k =>
            match env_lookup E k with
            | Some sv => match sv_fam sv with Some F => F b u | None => True end
            | None => True
            end
        | _ => True
        end
    | tAbs _ _ => True
    | tJ _ _ _ => True
    | tPack _ _ _ => True
    | tLet _ _ _ _ => True
    | tInd _ _ _ _ => True
    | tSeq _ _ _ => True
    end.

(* Well-formed semantic environments.  The [sv_ty]/[sv_fam] components are
   unconstrained here: the fundamental lemma will be proved for all of them,
   which is exactly what lets the Pi clause quantify over arbitrary semantic
   arguments. *)
Fixpoint EnvOk (G : context) (E : Env) {struct G} : Prop :=
  match G, E with
  | nil, nil => True

(* Semantic types are Prop-valued predicates on terms. *)
Definition SPred := tm -> Prop.

(* A type expression is "Void-free" if it has no parallel reduction path to
   tVoid.  This predicate is invariant under conversion (proved below) and is
   the uniform soundness guard for all type constructors. *)
Definition VoidFree (A : tm) : Prop := ~ rtc Par A tVoid.

(* A semantic type family, used to interpret a variable that is itself a
   type-level function (so that [tApp] as a type has a meaning). *)
Definition SFam := tm -> SPred.

(* Semantic environment entry: the term value, the level of the context entry,
   the semantic type when the value is used as a code, and the semantic type
   family when the value is used as a type-level function. *)
Record SV := {
  sv_tm  : tm;
  sv_lvl : T;
  sv_ty  : option SPred;
  sv_fam : option SFam
}.
Definition Env := list SV.

Definition env_lookup (E : Env) (i : fin) : option SV := nth_error E i.

Definition mkSV (l : T) (v : tm) (P : option SPred) (F : option SFam) : SV :=
  {| sv_tm := v; sv_lvl := l; sv_ty := P; sv_fam := F |}.

(* Level-indexed semantic predicate.  Every clause is conjoined with
   [VoidFree A]: any type with a reduction path to tVoid is empty, uniformly
   for all constructors (this is what makes T_Conv to tVoid sound).
   The Pi clause is negative; the Sig clause is the Church/negative encoding
   of dependent pairs; variables used as types/families are read from the
   environment.  The remaining type constructors are over-approximated by
   [True] under the VoidFree guard; this is sound for the consistency
   argument because the only informative case left is the Pi/Sig structure,
   and every Void-reducing type is excluded by the guard. *)
Fixpoint csem (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) {struct A} : SPred :=
  fun u =>
    VoidFree A /\
    match A with
    | tVoid => False
    | tUnit => True
    | tNat => True
    | tUniv _ => True
    | tPi l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (sv : SV), sv_lvl sv = l0 ->
           csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv) ->
           csem l B (sv :: E) (tApp u l0 (sv_tm sv)))
        /\
        (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
         else forall (sv1 sv2 : SV) (x : tm),
             csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv1) -> csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv2) ->
             (csem l B (sv1 :: E) x <-> csem l B (sv2 :: E) x))
    | tSig l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (R : SPred),
           (forall (a b : tm), csem l0 A0 E a ->
              csem l B (mkSV l0 a None None :: E) b -> R (tPack l0 a b))
           -> R u)
    | tEq _ _ _ => True
    | tAbsurd _ => True
    | tSuc _ => True
    | tZero => True
    | tRefl => True
    | tTT => True
    | var_tm k =>
        match env_lookup E k with
        | Some sv => match sv_ty sv with Some P => P u | None => True end
        | None => True
        end
    | tApp f l0 b =>
        match f with
        | var_tm k =>
            match env_lookup E k with
            | Some sv => match sv_fam sv with Some F => F b u | None => True end
            | None => True
            end
        | _ => True
        end
    | tAbs _ _ => True
    | tJ _ _ _ => True
    | tPack _ _ _ => True
    | tLet _ _ _ _ => True
    | tInd _ _ _ _ => True
    | tSeq _ _ _ => True
    end.

(* Well-formed semantic environments.  The [sv_ty]/[sv_fam] components are
   unconstrained here: the fundamental lemma will be proved for all of them,
   which is exactly what lets the Pi clause quantify over arbitrary semantic
   arguments. *)
Fixpoint EnvOk (G : context) (E : Env) {struct G} : Prop :=
  match G, E with
  | nil, nil => True
  | (l0, A) :: G', sv :: E' =>
      EnvOk G' E' /\ sv_lvl sv = l0 /\ csem l0 A E' (sv_tm sv)
  | _, _ => False
  end.

(* ---------- verified semantic rigidity lemmas ---------- *)

Lemma csem_voidfree : forall (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) (u : tm),
  csem l A E u -> VoidFree A.
Proof.
  intros l A E u. destruct A; cbn [csem]; intro H; exact (proj1 H).
Qed.

Lemma csem_void_elim : forall (l : T) (E : Env) (u : tm),
  csem l tVoid E u -> False.
Proof. intros l E u H. cbn [csem] in H. exact (proj2 H). Qed.

Lemma csem_conv_void_absurd :
  forall (Xi : econtext) (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) (u : tm),
    csem l A E u -> conv Xi A tVoid -> False.
Proof.
  intros Xi l A E u Hsem Hconv.
  apply (csem_voidfree l A E u Hsem).
  apply (conv_void Xi A Hconv).
Qed.

(* VoidFree is invariant under conversion. *)
Lemma voidfree_conv_iff : forall (Xi : econtext) (A B : tm),
  conv Xi A B -> (VoidFree A <-> VoidFree B).
Proof.
  intros Xi A B H. destruct H as [m [c0 [c1 [HA [HB HIEq]]]]].
  split; intros HV.
  - intro HBv. apply HV.
    assert (HvA : conv Xi A tVoid).
    { eapply conv_trans_void_r.
      - exists m, c0, c1. split; [exact HA | split; [exact HB | exact HIEq]].
      - apply (proj2 (conv_void_iff Xi m B)); exact HBv. }
    apply (proj1 (conv_void_iff Xi m A)); exact HvA.
  - intro HAv. apply HV.
    assert (HvB : conv Xi B tVoid).
    { eapply conv_trans_void_r.
      - apply conv_sym. exists m, c0, c1.
        split; [exact HA | split; [exact HB | exact HIEq]].
      - apply (proj2 (conv_void_iff Xi m A)); exact HAv. }
    apply (proj1 (conv_void_iff Xi m B)); exact HvB.
Qed.

Lemma VoidFree_pi : forall (l0 : T) (A B : tm), VoidFree (tPi l0 A B).
Proof.
  intros l0 A B H.
  assert (hpi tVoid) as [l [X [Y E]]].

(* Semantic types are Prop-valued predicates on terms. *)
Definition SPred := tm -> Prop.

(* A type expression is "Void-free" if it has no parallel reduction path to
   tVoid.  This predicate is invariant under conversion (proved below) and is
   the uniform soundness guard for all type constructors. *)
Definition VoidFree (A : tm) : Prop := ~ rtc Par A tVoid.

(* A semantic type family, used to interpret a variable that is itself a
   type-level function (so that [tApp] as a type has a meaning). *)
Definition SFam := tm -> SPred.

(* Semantic environment entry: the term value, the level of the context entry,
   the semantic type when the value is used as a code, and the semantic type
   family when the value is used as a type-level function. *)
Record SV := {
  sv_tm  : tm;
  sv_lvl : T;
  sv_ty  : option SPred;
  sv_fam : option SFam
}.
Definition Env := list SV.

Definition env_lookup (E : Env) (i : fin) : option SV := nth_error E i.

Definition mkSV (l : T) (v : tm) (P : option SPred) (F : option SFam) : SV :=
  {| sv_tm := v; sv_lvl := l; sv_ty := P; sv_fam := F |}.

(* Level-indexed semantic predicate.  Every clause is conjoined with
   [VoidFree A]: any type with a reduction path to tVoid is empty, uniformly
   for all constructors (this is what makes T_Conv to tVoid sound).
   The Pi clause is negative; the Sig clause is the Church/negative encoding
   of dependent pairs; variables used as types/families are read from the
   environment.  The remaining type constructors are over-approximated by
   [True] under the VoidFree guard; this is sound for the consistency
   argument because the only informative case left is the Pi/Sig structure,
   and every Void-reducing type is excluded by the guard. *)
Fixpoint csem (l : T) (A : tm) (E : Env) {struct A} : SPred :=
  fun u =>
    VoidFree A /\
    match A with
    | tVoid => False
    | tUnit => True
    | tNat => True
    | tUniv _ => True
    | tPi l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (sv : SV), sv_lvl sv = l0 ->
           csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv) ->
           csem l B (sv :: E) (tApp u l0 (sv_tm sv)))
        /\
        (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
         else forall (sv1 sv2 : SV) (x : tm),
             csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv1) -> csem l0 A0 E (sv_tm sv2) ->
             (csem l B (sv1 :: E) x <-> csem l B (sv2 :: E) x))
    | tSig l0 A0 B =>
        (forall (R : SPred),
           (forall (a b : tm), csem l0 A0 E a ->
              csem l B (mkSV l0 a None None :: E) b -> R (tPack l0 a b))
           -> R u)
    | tEq _ _ _ => True
    | tAbsurd _ => True
    | tSuc _ => True
    | tZero => True
    | tRefl => True
    | tTT => True
    | var_tm k =>
        match env_lookup E k with
        | Some sv => match sv_ty sv with Some P => P u | None => True end
        | None => True
        end
    | tApp f l0 b =>
        match f with
        | var_tm k =>
            match env_lookup E k with
            | Some sv => match sv_fam sv with Some F => F b u | None => True end
            | None => True
            end
        | _ => True
        end
    | tAbs _ _ => True
    | tJ _ _ _ => True
    | tPack _ _ _ => True
    | tLet _ _ _ _ => True
    | tInd _ _ _ _ => True
    | tSeq _ _ _ => True
    end.

(* Well-formed semantic environments.  The [sv_ty]/[sv_fam] components are
   unconstrained here: the fundamental lemma will be proved for all of them,
   which is exactly what lets the Pi clause quantify over arbitrary semantic
   arguments. *)
Fixpoint EnvOk (G : context) (E : Env) {struct G} : Prop :=
  match G, E with
  | nil, nil => True
  | (l0, A) :: G', sv :: E' =>
      EnvOk G' E' /\ sv_lvl sv = l0 /\ csem l0 A E' (sv_tm sv)
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition TySemClosure (R : T -> NEnv -> Val -> Val -> Prop) : Prop :=
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (i : fin) (v : Val),
      ee_code (nth i E empty_entry) v -> R l E (VVar i) v) /\
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (n : nat) (v : Val),
      R l E (VUniv n) v) /\
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (v : Val),
      v <> VVoid -> R l E VUnit v) /\
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (v : Val),
      v <> VVoid -> R l E VNat v) /\
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (l0 : T) (a b : Val) (v : Val),
      v <> VVoid -> R l E (VEq l0 a b) v) /\
  (forall (l : T) (E : NEnv) (l0 : T) (A : Val) (body : tm) (env : list Val)
      (f : Val),
      f <> VVoid ->
      (forall (x : Val) (e : NEnvEntry),
          ee_val e = x ->
          R l0 E A x ->
          forall (Bv r : Val),
            Eval body (x :: env) Bv -> Apply l0 f x r -> R l (e :: E) Bv r) ->
      (if T_eqb (l0 ∩ l) l0 then True
       else forall (x1 x2 : Val) (e1 e2 : NEnvEntry) (B1 B2 : Val),
           ee_val e1 = x1 -> ee_val e2 = x2 ->
           R l0 E A x1 -> R l0 E A x2 ->
           Eval body (x1 :: env) B1 -> Eval body (x2 :: env) B2 ->

Definition EvalDetObligation : Prop :=

Definition Det4Obligation : Prop :=
  (forall (l : T) (f x r : Val),
     Apply l f x r -> forall r', Apply l f x r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall (a : tm) (env : list Val) (v : Val),
     Eval a env v -> forall v', Eval a env v' -> v = v') /\

     IndEval l av b env cv r -> forall r',
       IndEval l av b env cv r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall (l0 l1 : T) (av : Val) (body : tm) (env : list Val) (r : Val),
     LetEval l0 l1 av body env r -> forall r',

Proof.

    TySem l E (VPi l0 A body env) f.
